1module cam_history
2!-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
3!
4! The cam_history module provides the user interface for CAM's history output capabilities.
5! It maintains the lists of fields that are written to each history file, and the associated
6! metadata for those fields such as descriptive names, physical units, time axis properties,
7! etc. It also contains the programmer interface which provides routines that are called from
8! the physics and dynamics initialization routines to define the fields that are produced by
9! the model and are available for output, and the routine that is called from the corresponding
10! run method to add the field values into a history buffer so that they may be output to disk.
11!
12! There are two special history files. The initial file and the satellite track file.
13!
14! Public functions/subroutines:
15! addfld, add_default
16! intht
17! write_restart_history
18! read_restart_history
19! outfld
20! get_field_properties
21! wshist
22! initialize_iop_history
23!-----------------------------------------------------------------------

179!
180!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
181!
182! Hashing.
183!
184! Accelerate outfld processing by using a hash function of the field name
185! to index masterlist and determine whehter the particular field is to
186! be written to any history tape.
187!
188!
189! Note: the outfld hashing logic will fail if any of the following are true:
190!
191! 1) The lower bound on the dimension of 'masterlist' is less than 1.
192!
193! 2) 'outfld' is called with field names that are not defined on
194! masterlist. This applies to both initial/branch and restart
195! runs.
196!
197! 3) An inconsistency between a field's tape active flag
198! 'masterlist(ff)%actflag(t)' and active fields read from
199! restart files.
200!
201! 4) Invoking function 'gen_hash_key' before the primary and secondary
202! hash tables have been created (routine bld_outfld_hash_tbls).
203!
204!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
205
206!
207! User definable constants for hash and overflow tables.
208! Define size of primary hash table (specified as 2**size).
209!
210 integer, parameter :: tbl_hash_pri_sz_lg2 = 16
211!
212! Define size of overflow hash table % of primary hash table.
213!
214 integer, parameter :: tbl_hash_oflow_percent = 20
215!
216! Do *not* modify the parameters below.
217!
218 integer, parameter :: tbl_hash_pri_sz = 2**tbl_hash_pri_sz_lg2
219 integer, parameter :: tbl_hash_oflow_sz = tbl_hash_pri_sz * (tbl_hash_oflow_percent/100.0_r8)
220!
221! The primary and overflow tables are organized to mimimize space (read:
222! try to maximimze cache line usage).
223!
224! gen_hash_key(fieldname) will return an index on the interval
225! [0 ... tbl_hash_pri_sz-1].
226!
227!
228! Primary:
229! gen_hash_key(fieldname)-------+ +----------+
230! | | -ii | 1 ------>tbl_hash_oflow(ii)
231! | +----------+
232! +--> | ff | 2 ------>masterlist(ff)
233! +----------+
234! | | ...
235! +----------+
236! | | tbl_hash_pri_sz
237! +----------+
238!
239! Overflow (if tbl_hash_pri() < 0):
240! tbl_hash_pri(gen_hash_key(fieldname))
241! |
242! | +----------+
243! | | 1 | 1 (one entry on O.F. chain)
244! | +----------+
245! | | ff_m | 2
246! | +----------+
247! +---------> | 3 | 3 (three entries on chain)
248! +----------+
249! | ff_x | 4
250! +----------+
251! | ff_y | 5
252! +----------+
253! | ff_z | 6
254! +----------+
255! | | ...
256! +----------+
257! | | tbl_hash_oflow_sz
258! +----------+
259!
260!
261 integer, dimension(0:tbl_hash_pri_sz-1) :: tbl_hash_pri ! Primary hash table
262 integer, dimension(tbl_hash_oflow_sz) :: tbl_hash_oflow ! Overflow hash table
263!
264! Constants used in hashing function gen_hash_key.
265! Note: if the constants in table 'tbl_gen_hash_key' below are modified,
266! changes are required to routine 'gen_hash_key' because of specific
267! logic in the routine that optimizes character strings of length 8.
268!
269
270 integer, parameter :: gen_hash_key_offset = z'000053db'
271
272 integer, parameter :: tbl_max_idx = 15 ! 2**N - 1
273 integer, dimension(0:tbl_max_idx) :: tbl_gen_hash_key = &
274 (/61,59,53,47,43,41,37,31,29,23,17,13,11,7,3,1/)

345512512 subroutine intht ()
346!
347!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
348!
349! Purpose: Initialize history file handler for initial or continuation run.
350! For example, on an initial run, this routine initializes "ptapes"
351! history files. On a restart or regeneration run, this routine
352! only initializes history files declared beyond what existed on the
353! previous run. Files which already existed on the previous run have
354! already been initialized (i.e. named and opened) in routine RESTRT.
355!
356! Method: Loop over tapes and fields per tape setting appropriate variables and
357! calling appropriate routines
358!
359! Author: CCM Core Group
360!
361!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
362 use ioFileMod
363 use shr_sys_mod, only: shr_sys_getenv

365 use cam_control_mod, only: nsrest

367 use sat_hist, only: sat_hist_init
368#if (defined SPMD)
369 use spmd_utils, only : mpichar, mpicom
370#endif
371!
372!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
373!
374! Local workspace
375!
376 integer :: t, f ! tape, field indices
377 integer :: begdim1 ! on-node dim1 start index
378 integer :: enddim1 ! on-node dim1 end index
379 integer :: begdim2 ! on-node dim2 start index
380 integer :: enddim2 ! on-node dim2 end index
381 integer :: begdim3 ! on-node chunk or lat start index
382 integer :: enddim3 ! on-node chunk or lat end index
383 type (dim_index_3d) :: dimind ! 3-D dimension index
384 integer :: day, sec ! day and seconds from base date
385 integer :: i, ii, ff ! index
386 integer :: rcode ! shr_sys_getenv return code
387 type(master_entry), pointer :: listentry
388 character(len=32) :: fldname ! temp variable used to produce a left justified field name
389 ! in the formatted logfile output
390
391!
392! Print master field list
393!
394
395512512 if (masterproc) then
39612 write(iulog,*) ' '
39712 write(iulog,*)' ******* MASTER FIELD LIST *******'
398 end if
399512512 listentry=>masterlinkedlist
400 f=0
40110209283062784 do while(associated(listentry))
40210204161020416 f=f+1
403 if(masterproc) then
40419931993 fldname = listentry%field%name
405199313951 write(iulog,9000) f, fldname, listentry%field%units, listentry%field%numlev, &
40619933986 listentry%avgflag(1), trim(listentry%field%long_name)
4079000 format(i5, 1x, a32, 1x, a16, 1x, i4, 1x, a1, 2x, a)
408 end if
40910204161020416 listentry=>listentry%next_entry
410 end do
411512512 nfmaster = f
41213 if(masterproc) write(iulog,*)'BLDFLD:nfmaster=',nfmaster
413
414!
415! Now that masterlinkedlist is defined and we are performing a restart run
416! (after all addfld calls), construct primary and secondary hashing tables.
417!
418512512 if ( nsrest==1 ) then
41900 call bld_outfld_hash_tbls()
42000 call bld_htapefld_indices()
421 return
422 end if
423!
424! Get users logname and machine hostname
425!
426512512 if ( masterproc )then
42711 logname = ' '
42811 call shr_sys_getenv ('LOGNAME',logname,rcode)
42911 host = ' '
43011 call shr_sys_getenv ('HOST',host,rcode)
431 end if
432#ifdef SPMD
433! PIO requires netcdf attributes have consistant values on all tasks
434512512 call mpibcast(logname, len(logname), mpichar, 0, mpicom)
435512512 call mpibcast(host, len(host), mpichar, 0, mpicom)
436#endif
437!
438! Override averaging flag for all fields on a particular tape if namelist input so specifies
439!
44061446656 do t=1,ptapes
44161446144 if (avgflag_pertape(t) /= ' ') then
44200 call h_override (t)
443 end if
444 end do
445!
446! Define field list information for all history files.
447!
448512512 call fldlst ()
449!
450! Loop over max. no. of history files permitted
451!
452512512 if ( nsrest .eq. 3 ) then
45300 call get_prev_time(day, sec) ! elapased time since reference date
454 else
455512512 call get_curr_time(day, sec) ! elapased time since reference date
456 end if
45761446656 do t=1,ptapes
458 nfils(t) = 0 ! no. of time samples in hist. file no. t
459
460! Time at beginning of current averaging interval.
461
462 beg_time(t) = day + sec/86400._r8
463 end do
464
465!
466! Initialize history variables
467!
46861446656 do t=1,ptapes
469125440131584 do f=1,nflds(t)
470125440125440 begdim1 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim1
471 enddim1 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim1
472 begdim2 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim2
473 enddim2 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim2

475 enddim3 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim3
4761254401128960 allocate(tape(t)%hlist(f)%hbuf(begdim1:enddim1,begdim2:enddim2,begdim3:enddim3))
4777005798484197376 tape(t)%hlist(f)%hbuf = 0._r8
478125440244224 if(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%flag_xyfill .or. (avgflag_pertape(t) .eq. 'L')) then
479665653248 allocate (tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs(begdim1:enddim1,begdim3:enddim3))
480 else
481118784712704 allocate (tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs(1,begdim3:enddim3))
482 end if
4834505601454080 tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs(:,:)=0
484 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%vector_compliment=0

521 end if

746512512 subroutine init_restart_history (File)
747
748!--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
749!
750! Arguments
751!
752 type(file_desc_t), intent(inout) :: File ! Pio file Handle
753!
754! Local
755!
756 integer :: dimids(4), ndims
757 integer :: ierr, i, k
758
759 ! Don't need to write restart data if we have written the file this step
76061447168 where (hstwr(:))
761614413312 rgnht(:) = .false.
762 elsewhere
763614419456 rgnht(:) = .true.
764 end where
765
766614414336 if(maxval(nflds)>0) then
767512512 call restart_vars_setnames()
768512512 call restart_dims_setnames()
769
770512512 call pio_seterrorhandling(File, PIO_BCAST_ERROR)
77140964608 do i=1,restartdimcnt
772 ! it's possible that one or more of these have been defined elsewhere
77340968192 ierr = pio_inq_dimid(File,restartdims(i)%name, restartdims(i)%dimid)
774 if(ierr/=PIO_NOERR) then
77535847168 ierr = pio_def_dim(File,restartdims(i)%name, restartdims(i)%len, &
776 restartdims(i)%dimid)
777 end if
778 end do
779512512 call pio_seterrorhandling(File, PIO_INTERNAL_ERROR)
780
7811536015872 do i=1,restartvarcnt
7821536015360 ndims= restartvars(i)%ndims
7832918429184 do k=1,ndims
784 dimids(k)=restartdims(restartvars(i)%dims(k))%dimid
785 end do
7861536015360 allocate(restartvars(i)%vdesc)
7871536030720 ierr = pio_def_var(File, restartvars(i)%name, restartvars(i)%type, dimids(1:ndims), restartvars(i)%vdesc)
788 end do
789 end if
790512512 end subroutine init_restart_history
791
7921536015360 function restartvar_getdesc(name) result(vdesc)
793 character(len=*), intent(in) :: name
794 type(var_desc_t), pointer :: vdesc
795 character(len=max_chars) :: errmsg
796 integer :: i
797
7981536015360 nullify(vdesc)
799222720222720 do i=1,restartvarcnt
800238080476160 if(name .eq. restartvars(i)%name) then
8011536015360 vdesc=>restartvars(i)%vdesc
802 exit
803 end if
804 end do
8051536046080 if(.not.associated(vdesc)) then
80600 errmsg = 'Could not find restart variable '//name
80700 call endrun(errmsg)
808 end if
8091536015360 end function restartvar_getdesc

818 !--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

837 mdims_desc, fillval_desc, issubcol_desc

842
843614413824 maxnflds = maxval(nflds)
8445122560 allocate(xyfill(maxnflds, ptapes))
84511304961149952 xyfill = 0
8465123072 allocate(is_subcol(maxnflds, ptapes))
84711304961149952 is_subcol = 0
848 !
849 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
850 ! Write the history restart data if necessary

852
85361447168 rgnht_int(:) = 0
854
85561449728 if(.not.allocated(restarthistory_tape)) allocate(restarthistory_tape(ptapes))
856
85761446656 do t=1,ptapes
858 ! No need to write history IC restart because it is always instantaneous
859614412800 if (is_initfile(file_index=t)) rgnht(t) = .false.
860 ! No need to write restart data for empty files
861614411264 if (nflds(t) == 0) rgnht(t) = .false.
86261446144 if(rgnht(t)) then
863512512 rgnht_int(t) = 1
864 restarthistory_tape(t)%hlist => history_tape(t)%hlist
865
8665121024 if(associated(history_tape(t)%column)) then
867512512 restarthistory_tape(t)%column => history_tape(t)%column
868 end if
8695121536 if(associated(history_tape(t)%column_st)) then
87000 restarthistory_tape(t)%column_st => history_tape(t)%column_st
871 end if
872 end if
873 end do
874
875614414336 if(maxval(nflds)<=0) return
876
877512512 call wshist(rgnht)
878
8795121024 vdesc => restartvar_getdesc('fincl')
8805121536 ierr= pio_put_var(File, vdesc, fincl(:,1:ptapes))
881
8825121024 vdesc => restartvar_getdesc('fincllonlat')

884
8855121024 vdesc => restartvar_getdesc('fexcl')
8865121536 ierr= pio_put_var(File, vdesc, fexcl(:,1:ptapes))
887
8885121024 vdesc => restartvar_getdesc('rgnht')
8895121536 ierr= pio_put_var(File, vdesc, rgnht_int(1:ptapes))
890
8915121024 vdesc => restartvar_getdesc('nhtfrq')
8925121536 ierr= pio_put_var(File, vdesc, nhtfrq(1:ptapes))
893
8945121024 vdesc => restartvar_getdesc('nflds')
8955121536 ierr= pio_put_var(File, vdesc, nflds(1:ptapes))
896
8975121024 vdesc => restartvar_getdesc('nfils')
8985121536 ierr= pio_put_var(File, vdesc, nfils(1:ptapes))
899
9005121024 vdesc => restartvar_getdesc('mfilt')
9015121536 ierr= pio_put_var(File, vdesc, mfilt(1:ptapes))
902
9035121024 vdesc => restartvar_getdesc('nfpath')
9045121536 ierr= pio_put_var(File, vdesc, nfpath(1:ptapes))
905
9065121024 vdesc => restartvar_getdesc('cpath')
9075121536 ierr= pio_put_var(File, vdesc, cpath(1:ptapes))
908
9095121024 vdesc => restartvar_getdesc('nhfil')
9105121536 ierr= pio_put_var(File, vdesc, nhfil(1:ptapes))
911
9125121024 vdesc => restartvar_getdesc('ndens')
9135121536 ierr= pio_put_var(File, vdesc, ndens(1:ptapes))
9145121024 vdesc => restartvar_getdesc('ncprec')
9155121536 ierr= pio_put_var(File, vdesc, ncprec(1:ptapes))
9165121024 vdesc => restartvar_getdesc('ngroup')
9175121536 ierr= pio_put_var(File, vdesc, ngroup(1:ptapes))
9185121024 vdesc => restartvar_getdesc('beg_time')
9195121536 ierr= pio_put_var(File, vdesc, beg_time(1:ptapes))
920
9215121024 vdesc => restartvar_getdesc('hrestpath')
9225121536 ierr = pio_put_var(File, vdesc, hrestpath(1:ptapes))
923
9245121024 vdesc => restartvar_getdesc('lcltod_start')
9255121536 ierr = pio_put_var(File, vdesc, lcltod_start(1:ptapes))
926
9275121024 vdesc => restartvar_getdesc('lcltod_stop')
9285121536 ierr = pio_put_var(File, vdesc, lcltod_stop(1:ptapes))
929
9305121024 field_name_desc => restartvar_getdesc('field_name')
9315121024 decomp_type_desc => restartvar_getdesc('decomp_type')
9325121024 numlev_desc => restartvar_getdesc('numlev')
9335121024 hwrt_prec_desc => restartvar_getdesc('hwrt_prec')
934
9355121024 sseq_desc => restartvar_getdesc('sampling_seq')
9365121024 longname_desc => restartvar_getdesc('long_name')
9375121024 units_desc => restartvar_getdesc('units')
9385121024 avgflag_desc => restartvar_getdesc('avgflag')
9395121024 xyfill_desc => restartvar_getdesc('xyfill')
9405121024 issubcol_desc => restartvar_getdesc('is_subcol')
941
9425121024 mdims_desc => restartvar_getdesc('mdims')
9435121024 fillval_desc => restartvar_getdesc('fillvalue')
944
945 tape=>history_tape
946
947614417408 allocate(allmdims(maxvarmdims,maxval(nflds),ptapes))
94811304964541440 allmdims=-1
949
950512512 startc(1)=1
95161446144 do t = 1,ptapes
95261446144 start(2)=t
953 startc(3)=t
954125440125440 do f=1,nflds(t)
955125440125440 start(1)=f
956 startc(2)=f
957125440376320 ierr = pio_put_var(File, field_name_desc,startc,tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%name)
958125440376320 ierr = pio_put_var(File, decomp_type_desc,start,tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%decomp_type)
959125440376320 ierr = pio_put_var(File, numlev_desc,start,tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%numlev)
960
961125440376320 ierr = pio_put_var(File, hwrt_prec_desc,start,tape(t)%hlist(f)%hwrt_prec)
962125440376320 ierr = pio_put_var(File, sseq_desc,startc,tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%sampling_seq)
963125440376320 ierr = pio_put_var(File, longname_desc,startc,tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%long_name)
964125440376320 ierr = pio_put_var(File, units_desc,startc,tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%units)
965125440376320 ierr = pio_put_var(File, avgflag_desc,start, tape(t)%hlist(f)%avgflag)
966
967125440376320 ierr = pio_put_var(File, fillval_desc,start, tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%fillvalue)
968125440250880 if(associated(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%mdims)) then
96971168213504 allmdims(1:size(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%mdims),f,t) = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%mdims
970 end if
971125440132096 if(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%flag_xyfill) xyfill(f,t) = 1
972125440125440 if(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%is_subcol) is_subcol(f,t) = 1
973 end do
974 end do
9755121024 ierr = pio_put_var(File, xyfill_desc, xyfill)

9775121024 ierr = pio_put_var(File, issubcol_desc, is_subcol)

987 subroutine read_restart_history (File)
988 use pio, only : pio_inquire_variable, pio_inq_dimid, pio_inquire, &
989 pio_inq_varid, pio_inquire_dimension, pio_inq_dimname
990
991 use ppgrid, only: begchunk, endchunk
992 use phys_grid, only: get_ncols_p
993 use rgrid, only: nlon
994 use dycore, only: dycore_is
995 use cam_pio_utils, only: cam_pio_openfile, phys_decomp, dyn_decomp, dyn_stagger_decomp, get_decomp
996 use ioFileMod, only: getfil
997 use sat_hist, only: sat_hist_define, sat_hist_init
998
999 use shr_sys_mod, only: shr_sys_getenv
1000#if (defined SPMD)
1001 use spmd_utils, only : iam, mpicom, mpichar
1002#endif
1003!
1004!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1005!
1006! Arguments
1007!
1008 type(file_desc_t), intent(inout) :: File ! unit number
1009!
1010! Local workspace
1011!
1012 integer t, f ! tape, field indices
1013 integer c ! chunk or lat index
1014 integer lenc ! length of useful character data
1015 integer numlev ! number of vertical levels (dimension and loop)
1016 integer begdim2 ! on-node vert start index
1017 integer enddim2 ! on-node vert end index
1018 integer ioerr ! error code from read()
1019 integer begdim1 ! on-node dim1 start index
1020 integer enddim1 ! on-node dim1 end index
1021 integer begdim3 ! on-node chunk or lat start index
1022 integer enddim3 ! on-node chunk or lat end index
1023 integer ncol ! number of active columns per chunk
1024 integer lenarr ! global size of array to be read
1025 integer flag_xyfill_int
1026
1027
1028 integer rgnht_int(ptapes)
1029 integer :: ierr
1030
1031 character(len=max_string_len) :: locfn ! Local filename
1032 character(len=max_fieldname_len), allocatable :: tmpname(:,:)
1033 integer, allocatable :: decomp(:,:), tmpnumlev(:,:)
1034 integer, pointer :: nacs(:,:) ! accumulation counter
1035 character(len=max_fieldname_len) :: fname_tmp ! local copy of field name
1036 character(len=max_fieldname_len) :: dname_tmp ! local copy of dim name
1037 character(len=max_chars), pointer :: tmpstr
1038
1039 real(r8) :: sum_r8
1040 real(r4) :: sum_r4
1041
1042 type (dim_index_3d) :: dimind, dimind_xyz, dimind_xzy ! 3-D dimension index
1043 integer :: ii, i, j, k, ptapes_dimid, vsize
1044 integer :: beglatxy, endlatxy, beglat, endlat, beglonxy, endlonxy, beglon, endlon
1045
1046 type(var_desc_t) :: vdesc, longname_desc, units_desc, avgflag_desc, sseq_desc, fillval_desc
1047 type(io_desc_t), pointer :: iodesc
1048 real(r8), allocatable :: tmpfldr8(:)
1049 real(r4), allocatable :: tmpfldr4(:)
1050 integer, allocatable :: tmpfldi(:), tmpprec(:,:)
1051 character(len=1), allocatable:: tmpavgflag(:, :)
1052 integer, allocatable :: xyfill(:,:), is_subcol(:,:), allmdims(:,:,:)
1053 integer :: nacsdimcnt, nacsval
1054 integer :: maxnflds, dimid
1055 type(master_entry), pointer :: listentry
1056
1057 character(len=16), allocatable :: mdimnames(:) ! Names of all hist coords (inc. vertical)
1058 integer :: ndims, dimids(8)
1059 integer :: tmpdims(8), dimcnt
1060 integer :: mtapes, mdimcnt
1061!
1062! Get users logname and machine hostname
1063!
1064 if ( masterproc )then
1065 logname = ' '
1066 call shr_sys_getenv ('LOGNAME',logname,ierr)
1067 host = ' '
1068 call shr_sys_getenv ('HOST',host,ierr)
1069 end if
1070#ifdef SPMD
1071 ! PIO requires netcdf attributes have consistant values on all tasks
1072 call mpibcast(logname, len(logname), mpichar, 0, mpicom)
1073 call mpibcast(host, len(host), mpichar, 0, mpicom)
1074#endif
1075
1076
1077 beglonxy = get_dyn_grid_parm('beglonxy')
1078 endlonxy = get_dyn_grid_parm('endlonxy')
1079 beglatxy = get_dyn_grid_parm('beglatxy')
1080 endlatxy = get_dyn_grid_parm('endlatxy')
1081 beglat = get_dyn_grid_parm('beglat')
1082 endlat = get_dyn_grid_parm('endlat')
1083 beglon = get_dyn_grid_parm('beglon')
1084 endlon = get_dyn_grid_parm('endlon')
1085
1086
1087 call pio_seterrorhandling(File, PIO_BCAST_ERROR)
1088
1089 ierr = pio_inq_dimid(File, 'ptapes', ptapes_dimid)
1090 if(ierr/= PIO_NOERR) then
1091 if(masterproc) write(iulog,*) 'Not reading history info from restart file', ierr
1092 return ! no history info in restart file
1093 end if
1094 call pio_seterrorhandling(File, PIO_INTERNAL_ERROR)
1095
1096 ierr = pio_inq_dimlen(File, ptapes_dimid, mtapes)
1097
1098 ierr = pio_inq_dimid(File, 'maxnflds', dimid)
1099 ierr = pio_inq_dimlen(File, dimid, maxnflds)
1100
1101 ierr = pio_inq_dimid(File, 'maxvarmdims', dimid)
1102 ierr = pio_inq_dimlen(File, dimid, maxvarmdims)
1103
1104
1105 ierr = pio_inq_varid(File, 'rgnht', vdesc)
1106 ierr = pio_get_var(File, vdesc, rgnht_int(1:mtapes))
1107

1125 ierr = pio_get_var(File, vdesc, hrestpath(1:mtapes))

1130 ierr = pio_inq_varid(File, 'ncprec', vdesc)

1148 ierr = pio_get_var(File, vdesc, lcltod_start(1:mtapes))

1151 ierr = pio_get_var(File, vdesc, lcltod_stop(1:mtapes))

1157 ierr = pio_inq_varid(File, 'field_name', vdesc)
1158 ierr = pio_get_var(File, vdesc, tmpname)
1159
1160 ierr = pio_inq_varid(File, 'decomp_type', vdesc)
1161 ierr = pio_get_var(File, vdesc, decomp)
1162 ierr = pio_inq_varid(File, 'numlev', vdesc)
1163 ierr = pio_get_var(File, vdesc, tmpnumlev)
1164
1165 allocate(tmpprec(maxnflds,mtapes))
1166 ierr = pio_inq_varid(File, 'hwrt_prec',vdesc)
1167 ierr = pio_get_var(File, vdesc, tmpprec(:,:))
1168
1169 allocate(xyfill(maxnflds,mtapes))
1170 ierr = pio_inq_varid(File, 'xyfill', vdesc)
1171 ierr = pio_get_var(File, vdesc, xyfill)
1172
1173 allocate(is_subcol(maxnflds,mtapes))
1174 ierr = pio_inq_varid(File, 'is_subcol', vdesc)
1175 ierr = pio_get_var(File, vdesc, is_subcol)
1176
1177 allocate(allmdims(maxvarmdims,maxnflds,mtapes))
1178 ierr = pio_inq_varid(File, 'mdims', vdesc)
1179 ierr = pio_get_var(File, vdesc, allmdims)
1180
1181
1182 ierr = pio_inq_varid(File, 'avgflag', avgflag_desc)
1183
1184 ierr = pio_inq_varid(File, 'long_name', longname_desc)
1185 ierr = pio_inq_varid(File, 'units', units_desc)
1186 ierr = pio_inq_varid(File, 'sampling_seq', sseq_desc)
1187
1188 ierr = pio_inq_varid(File, 'fillvalue', fillval_desc)
1189
1190
1191 rgnht(:)=.false.
1192
1193 allocate(history_tape(mtapes))
1194
1195 tape => history_tape
1196
1197 do t=1,mtapes
1198 nullify(tape(t)%column)
1199 nullify(tape(t)%column_st)
1200
1201 if(rgnht_int(t)==1) rgnht(t)=.true.
1202
1203
1204 call strip_null(nfpath(t))
1205 call strip_null(cpath(t))
1206 call strip_null(hrestpath(t))
1207 allocate(tape(t)%hlist(nflds(t)))
1208
1209 do f=1,nflds(t)
1210 nullify(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%mdims)
1211 ierr = pio_get_var(File,fillval_desc, (/f,t/), tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%fillvalue)
1212 ierr = pio_get_var(File,avgflag_desc, (/f,t/), tape(t)%hlist(f)%avgflag)
1213 ierr = pio_get_var(File,longname_desc, (/1,f,t/), tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%long_name)
1214 ierr = pio_get_var(File,units_desc, (/1,f,t/), tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%units)
1215 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%sampling_seq(1:max_chars) = ' '
1216 ierr = pio_get_var(File,sseq_desc, (/1,f,t/), tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%sampling_seq)
1217 call strip_null(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%sampling_seq)
1218 if(xyfill(f,t) ==1) then
1219 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%flag_xyfill=.true.
1220 else
1221 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%flag_xyfill=.false.
1222 end if
1223 if(is_subcol(f,t) ==1) then
1224 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%is_subcol=.true.
1225 else
1226 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%is_subcol=.false.
1227 end if
1228 call strip_null(tmpname(f,t))
1229 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%name = tmpname(f,t)
1230 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%decomp_type = decomp(f,t)
1231 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%numlev = tmpnumlev(f,t)
1232 tape(t)%hlist(f)%hwrt_prec = tmpprec(f,t)
1233
1234 mdimcnt = count(allmdims(:,f,t)>0)
1235 if(mdimcnt>0) then
1236 allocate(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%mdims(mdimcnt))
1237 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%mdims = allmdims(1:mdimcnt,f,t)
1238 end if
1239
1240 end do
1241 end do
1242 deallocate(tmpname, tmpnumlev, tmpprec, decomp, xyfill, is_subcol)
1243
1244 do t=1,ptapes
1245 do f=1,nflds(t)
1246 nullify(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%colperdim3)
1247 numlev = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%numlev
1248 select case (tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%decomp_type)
1249 case (phys_decomp)
1250 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim2= 1
1251 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim2= numlev
1252 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim3 = begchunk
1253 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim3 = endchunk
1254 allocate (tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%colperdim3(begchunk:endchunk))
1255 do c=begchunk,endchunk
1256 ncol = get_ncols_p(c)
1257 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%colperdim3(c) = ncol
1258 end do
1259 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim1 = 1
1260 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim1 = pcols
1261 case (dyn_decomp)
1262 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim1 = beglonxy
1263 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim1 = endlonxy
1264 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim3 = beglatxy
1265 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim3 = endlatxy
1266 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim2 = 1
1267 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim2 = numlev
1268
1269 if (.not. (dycore_is('LR') .or. dycore_is('UNSTRUCTURED'))) then
1270 allocate (tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%colperdim3(beglat:endlat))
1271 do c=beglat,endlat
1272 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%colperdim3(c) = nlon(c)
1273 end do
1274 end if
1275 case (dyn_stagger_decomp)
1276 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim1 = beglonxy
1277 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim1 = endlonxy
1278 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim2 = 1
1279 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim2 = numlev
1280 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim3 = beglatxy
1281 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim3 = endlatxy
1282 case default
1283 write(iulog,*)'READ_RESTART_HISTORY: bad decomp_type=',tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%decomp_type
1284 call endrun ()
1285 end select
1286
1287 begdim1 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim1
1288 enddim1 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim1
1289 begdim2 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim2
1290 enddim2 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim2
1291 begdim3 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim3
1292 enddim3 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim3
1293
1294 allocate(tape(t)%hlist(f)%hbuf(begdim1:enddim1,begdim2:enddim2,begdim3:enddim3))
1295
1296 nullify(tape(t)%hlist(f)%varid)
1297 nullify(tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs)
1298 if(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%flag_xyfill .or. (avgflag_pertape(t)=='L')) then
1299 allocate (tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs(begdim1:enddim1,begdim3:enddim3))
1300 else
1301 allocate(tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs(1,begdim3:enddim3))
1302 end if
1303 ! initialize all buffers to zero - this will be overwritten later by the
1304 ! data in the history restart file if it exists.
1305 call h_zero(f,t)
1306
1307
1308 end do
1309 end do
1310!
1311!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1312! Read history restart files
1313!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1314!
1315! Loop over the total number of history files declared and
1316! read the pathname for any history restart files
1317! that are present (if any). Test to see if the run is a restart run
1318! AND if any history buffer regen files exist (rgnht=.T.). Note, rgnht
1319! is preset to false, reset to true in routine WSDS if hbuf restart files
1320! are written and saved in the master restart file. Each history buffer
1321! restart file is then obtained.
1322! Note: some f90 compilers (e.g. SGI) complain about I/O of
1323! derived types which have pointer components, so explicitly read each one.
1324!
1325 do t=1,mtapes
1326 if (rgnht(t)) then
1327!
1328! Open history restart file
1329!
1330 call getfil (hrestpath(t), locfn)
1331 call cam_pio_openfile(tape(t)%File, locfn, 0)
1332!
1333! Read history restart file
1334!
1335! Read the hist coord names to pre-register
1336 ! We will take our chances if the variable is not present
1337 call pio_seterrorhandling(tape(t)%File, PIO_BCAST_ERROR)
1338 ierr = pio_inq_varid(tape(t)%File, mdim_var_name, vdesc)
1339 call pio_seterrorhandling(tape(t)%File, PIO_INTERNAL_ERROR)
1340 if (ierr /= PIO_NOERR) then
1341 ierr = pio_inquire_variable(tape(t)%File, vdesc, dimids=dimids)
1342 ierr = pio_inq_dimlen(tape(t)%File, dimids(1), mdimcnt)
1343 allocate(mdimnames(mdimcnt))
1344 ierr = pio_get_var(tape(t)%File, vdesc, mdimnames)
1345 do f = 1, mdimcnt
1346 call add_hist_coord(mdimnames(f))
1347 end do
1348 deallocate(mdimnames)
1349 end if
1350
1351 do f=1,nflds(t)
1352 begdim1 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim1
1353 enddim1 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim1
1354 begdim2 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim2
1355 enddim2 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim2
1356 begdim3 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim3
1357 enddim3 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim3
1358 numlev = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%numlev
1359
1360 fname_tmp = strip_suffix(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%name)
1361 if(masterproc) write(iulog, *) 'Reading history variable ',fname_tmp
1362 ierr = pio_inq_varid(tape(t)%File, fname_tmp, vdesc)
1363
1364
1365 if(.not. associated(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%mdims)) then
1366 ierr = pio_inquire_variable(tape(t)%File, vdesc, ndims=ndims,dimids=dimids)
1367 dimcnt = 0
1368 do i=1,ndims
1369 ierr = pio_inq_dimname(tape(t)%File, dimids(i), dname_tmp)
1370 dimid = get_hist_coord_index(dname_tmp)
1371 if(dimid >= 1) then
1372 dimcnt = dimcnt + 1
1373 tmpdims(dimcnt) = dimid
1374 end if
1375 end do
1376 if(dimcnt > 0) then
1377 allocate(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%mdims(dimcnt))
1378 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%mdims(:) = tmpdims(1:dimcnt)
1379 if(dimcnt > maxvarmdims) maxvarmdims=dimcnt
1380 end if
1381 end if
1382 call get_decomp(iodesc, tape(t)%hlist(f)%field, pio_double)
1383 call pio_read_darray(tape(t)%File, vdesc, iodesc, tape(t)%hlist(f)%hbuf, ierr)
1384
1385 ierr = pio_inq_varid(tape(t)%File, trim(fname_tmp)//'_nacs', vdesc)
1386 ierr = pio_inq_varndims(tape(t)%File, vdesc, nacsdimcnt)
1387
1388 if(nacsdimcnt>0) then
1389 call get_decomp(iodesc, tape(t)%hlist(f)%field, pio_int, numlev_in=1)
1390 allocate(tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs(begdim1:enddim1,begdim3:enddim3))
1391
1392 nacs => tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs(:,:)
1393 call pio_read_darray(tape(t)%File, vdesc, iodesc, nacs, ierr)
1394 else
1395 allocate(tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs(1,begdim3:enddim3))
1396 ierr = pio_get_var(tape(t)%File, vdesc, nacsval)
1397 tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs(1,:)= nacsval
1398 end if
1399
1400
1401
1402 end do
1403!
1404! Done reading this history restart file
1405!
1406 call pio_closefile (tape(t)%File)
1407
1408 end if ! rgnht(t)
1409 call column_init(t, nflds(t))
1410 end do ! end of do mtapes loop
1411
1412
1413
1414
1415!
1416! If the history files are partially complete (contain less than
1417! mfilt(t) time samples, then get the files and open them.)
1418!
1419! NOTE: No need to perform this operation for IC history files or empty files
1420!
1421
1422 do t=1,mtapes
1423 if (is_initfile(file_index=t)) then
1424 ! Initialize filename specifier for IC file
1425 hfilename_spec(t) = '%c.cam' // trim(inst_suffix) // '.i.%y-%m-%d-%s.nc'
1426 nfils(t) = 0
1427 else if (nflds(t) == 0) then
1428 nfils(t) = 0
1429 else
1430 if (nfils(t) > 0) then
1431 call getfil (cpath(t), locfn)
1432 call cam_pio_openfile(tape(t)%File, locfn, PIO_WRITE)
1433 call h_inquire (t)
1434 if(is_satfile(t)) then
1435 ! Initialize the sat following history subsystem
1436 call sat_hist_init()
1437 call sat_hist_define(tape(t)%File)
1438 end if
1439 end if
1440 !
1441 ! If the history file is full, close the current unit
1442 !
1443 if (nfils(t) >= mfilt(t)) then
1444 if (masterproc) then
1445 write(iulog,*)'READ_RESTART_HISTORY: nf_close(',t,')=',nhfil(t), mfilt(t)
1446 end if
1447 do f=1,nflds(t)
1448 deallocate(tape(t)%hlist(f)%varid)
1449 nullify(tape(t)%hlist(f)%varid)
1450 end do
1451 call pio_closefile(tape(t)%File)
1452 nfils(t) = 0
1453 end if
1454 end if
1455 end do
1456
1457 ! Setup vector pairs for unstructured grid interpolation
1458 call setup_interpolation_and_define_vector_compliments()
1459
1460 if(mtapes/=ptapes .and. masterproc) then
1461 write(iulog,*) ' WARNING: Restart file ptapes setting ',mtapes,' not equal to model setting ',ptapes
1462 end if
1463
1464 return
1465 end subroutine read_restart_history

151613742771201374277120 recursive function get_entry_by_name(listentry, name) result(entry)
1517 type(master_entry), pointer :: listentry
1518 character(len=*), intent(in) :: name ! variable name
1519 type(master_entry), pointer :: entry
1520
152113742771204122831360 if(associated(listentry)) then
152213732567042746513408 if(listentry%field%name .eq. name) then
1523250880250880 entry => listentry
1524 else
152513730058244119017472 entry=>get_entry_by_name(listentry%next_entry, name)
1526 end if
1527 else
152810204161020416 nullify(entry)
1529 end if
153013742771201374277120 end function get_entry_by_name

1534
1535512512 subroutine fldlst ()
1536
1537 use dycore, only : dycore_is
1538!
1539!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1540!
1541! Purpose: Define the contents of each history file based on namelist input for initial or branch
1542! run, and restart data if a restart run.
1543!
1544! Method: Use arrays fincl and fexcl to modify default history tape contents.
1545! Then sort the result alphanumerically for later use by OUTFLD to
1546! allow an n log n search time.
1547!
1548!---------------------------Local variables-----------------------------
1549!
1550 integer t, f ! tape, field indices
1551 integer ff ! index into include, exclude and fprec list
1552 character(len=fieldname_len) :: name ! field name portion of fincl (i.e. no avgflag separator)
1553 character(len=max_fieldname_len) :: mastername ! name from masterlist field
1554 character(len=max_chars) :: tmpcolumn_name,latlonname,latlonnamep1 ! tmp char fields
1555 character(len=1) :: avgflag ! averaging flag
1556 character(len=1) :: prec_wrt ! history buffer write precision flag
1557 character(len=6) :: prec_str
1558 character(len=32) :: fldname
1559
1560 type (hentry) :: tmp ! temporary used for swapping
1561 type (column_info) :: tmpcolumn ! temporary used for swapping
1562
1563 type(master_entry), pointer :: listentry
1564
1565
1566!
1567! First ensure contents of fincl, fexcl, and fwrtpr are all valid names
1568!
156961446656 do t=1,ptapes
157061446144 f = 1
1571614412288 do while (f < pflds .and. fincl(f,t) /= ' ')
157200 name = getname (fincl(f,t))
157300 mastername=''
157400 listentry => get_entry_by_name(masterlinkedlist, name)
157500 if(associated(listentry)) mastername = listentry%field%name
157600 if (name /= mastername) then
157700 write(iulog,*)'FLDLST: ', trim(name), ' in fincl(', f, ') not found'
157800 call endrun
1579 end if
158000 f = f + 1
1581 end do
1582
158361446144 f = 1
1584614412288 do while (f < pflds .and. fexcl(f,t) /= ' ')
158500 mastername=''
158600 listentry => get_entry_by_name(masterlinkedlist, fexcl(f,t))
158700 if(associated(listentry)) mastername = listentry%field%name
1588
158900 if (fexcl(f,t) /= mastername) then
159000 write(iulog,*)'FLDLST: ', fexcl(f,t), ' in fexcl(', f, ') not found'
159100 call endrun
1592 end if
159300 f = f + 1
1594 end do
1595
159661446144 f = 1
1597614412288 do while (f < pflds .and. fwrtpr(f,t) /= ' ')
159800 name = getname (fwrtpr(f,t))
159900 mastername=''
160000 listentry => get_entry_by_name(masterlinkedlist, name)
160100 if(associated(listentry)) mastername = listentry%field%name
160200 if (name /= mastername) then
160300 write(iulog,*)'FLDLST: ', trim(name), ' in fwrtpr(', f, ') not found'
160400 call endrun
1605 end if
160600 do ff=1,f-1 ! If duplicate entry is found, stop
160700 if (trim(name) == trim(getname(fwrtpr(ff,t)))) then
160800 write(iulog,*)'FLDLST: Duplicate field ', name, ' in fwrtpr'
160900 call endrun
1610 end if
1611 end do
161200 f = f + 1
1613 end do
1614 end do
1615
161661447168 nflds(:) = 0
1617 ! IC history file is to be created, set properties

1853125440125440 subroutine inifld (t, listentry, avgflag, prec_wrt)
1854!
1855!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1856!
1857! Purpose: Add a field to the active list for a history tape
1858!
1859! Method: Copy the data from the master field list to the active list for the tape
1860! Also: define mapping arrays from (col,chunk) -> (lon,lat)
1861!
1862! Author: CCM Core Group
1863!
1864!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1865
1866
1867!
1868! Arguments
1869!
1870 integer, intent(in) :: t ! history tape index
1871
1872 type(master_entry), pointer :: listentry
1873
1874 character*1, intent(in) :: avgflag ! averaging flag
1875 character*1, intent(in) :: prec_wrt ! history output precision flag
1876!
1877! Local workspace
1878!
1879 integer :: i ! index
1880 integer :: n ! field index on defined tape
1881
1882
1883!
1884! Ensure that it is not to late to add a field to the history tape
1885!
1886125440125440 if (htapes_defined) then
188700 call endrun ('INIFLD: Attempt to add field '//listentry%field%name//' after history files set')
1888 end if
1889
1890
1891125440125440 nflds(t) = nflds(t) + 1
1892 n = nflds(t)
1893!
1894! Copy field info.
1895!
1896 if(n > size(tape(t)%hlist)) then
189700 write(iulog,*) 'tape field miscount error ', n, size(tape(t)%hlist)
189800 call endrun()
1899 end if
1900
1901125440125440 tape(t)%hlist(n)%field = listentry%field
1902
1903 select case (prec_wrt)
1904 case (' ')
1905125440125440 if (ndens(t) == 1) then
19063123231232 tape(t)%hlist(n)%hwrt_prec = 8
1907 else
19089420894208 tape(t)%hlist(n)%hwrt_prec = 4
1909 end if
1910 case ('4')
191100 tape(t)%hlist(n)%hwrt_prec = 4
1912 if (masterproc) then
191300 write(iulog,*) 'INIFLD: Output data type for ', tape(t)%hlist(n)%field%name, &
1914 ' is real*4'
1915 end if
1916 case ('8')
191700 tape(t)%hlist(n)%hwrt_prec = 8
1918 if (masterproc) then
191900 write(iulog,*) 'INIFLD: Output data type for ', tape(t)%hlist(n)%field%name, &
1920 ' is real*8'
1921 end if
1922 case default
192300 call endrun ('INIFLD: unknown prec_wrt='//prec_wrt)
1924 end select
1925!
1926! Override the default averaging (masterlist) averaging flag if non-blank
1927!
1928125440125440 if (avgflag == ' ') then
1929125440125440 tape(t)%hlist(n)%avgflag = listentry%avgflag(t)
1930125440125440 tape(t)%hlist(n)%time_op = listentry%time_op(t)
1931 else
193200 tape(t)%hlist(n)%avgflag = avgflag
193300 select case (avgflag)
193400 case ('A')
193500 tape(t)%hlist(n)%time_op = 'mean'
193600 case ('B')
193700 tape(t)%hlist(n)%time_op = 'mean00z'
193800 case ('I')
193900 tape(t)%hlist(n)%time_op = ' '
194000 case ('X')
194100 tape(t)%hlist(n)%time_op = 'maximum'
194200 case ('M')
194300 tape(t)%hlist(n)%time_op = 'minimum'
194400 case('L')
194500 tape(t)%hlist(n)%time_op = LT_DESC
1946 case default
194700 call endrun ('INIFLD: unknown avgflag='//avgflag)
1948 end select
1949 end if
1950
1951#ifdef HDEBUG
1952 write(iulog,*)'HDEBUG: ',__LINE__,' field ', tape(t)%hlist(n)%field%name, ' added as ', 'field number ', n,' on tape ', t
1953 write(iulog,*)'units=',tape(t)%hlist(n)%field%units
1954 write(iulog,*)'numlev=',tape(t)%hlist(n)%field%numlev
1955 write(iulog,*)'avgflag=',tape(t)%hlist(n)%avgflag
1956 write(iulog,*)'time_op=',tape(t)%hlist(n)%time_op
1957 write(iulog,*)'hwrt_prec=',tape(t)%hlist(n)%hwrt_prec
1958#endif
1959
1960 return
1961125440125440 end subroutine inifld

2137614412288 allocate (tape(t)%column(1))
213861446144 nullify(tape(t)%column(1)%hmask)

2140125440250880 allocate (tape(t)%hlist(i)%field_column_name(1))
2141125440125440 tape(t)%hlist(i)%field_column_name(1) = ' '

214361446144 tape(t)%column(1)%lat_name=' '
214461446144 tape(t)%column(1)%lon_name=' '
21451228824576 tape(t)%column(1)%columnlon(:)=0
21461228824576 tape(t)%column(1)%columnlat(:)=0
214761446144 tape(t)%column(1)%num_lats=0
2148 tape(t)%column(1)%num_lons=0

2241
2242 subroutine getlatind(inname,beglatind,endlatind,latname,latdeg,mlat)
2243!
2244!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2245!
2246! Purpose: retrieve closest model lat index given north south latitude string
2247!
2248! Author: John Truesdale
2249!
2250!-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2251!
2252! Arguments
2253!
2254 character(len=*), intent(in) :: inname
2255 character(len=*), intent(out) :: latname
2256 integer, intent(out) :: beglatind,endlatind
2257 integer, intent(in) :: mlat
2258 real(r8), intent(in) :: latdeg(mlat)
2259!
2260! Local workspace
2261!
2262 character(len=max_chars) str1,str2,tmpstr(4)
2263 integer :: i,j,marker,latind(2),tmplen(4)
2264 real(r8) :: latdegree(2)
2265
2266!
2267!-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2268!
2269 str1=' '
2270 str2=' '
2271 tmpstr(:)= ' '
2272
2273!
2274! make sure _ separator is present
2275!
2276 if (scan(inname,'_').eq.0) then
2277 write(iulog,*)'GETLATIND: Improperly formatted column string. Missing underscore character (xxxE_yyyS) ', &
2278 inname,scan(inname,'_')
2279 call endrun
2280 end if
2281!
2282! split inname string into lat lon strings
2283!
2284 marker=scan(inname,'_')
2285 str1=inname(:marker-1)
2286 str2=inname(marker+1:)
2287
2288!
2289! split ranges of lats( or lons) into seperate substrings. Substrings 1,2 will contain lats(lons)
2290! from portion of string before underscore
2291! if a single column and not a range is specified substrings 1 and 2 will be the same
2292! and substrings 3,4 will contain lats(lons) from portion of main string after underscore character
2293! if a single column and not a range is specified substrings 3 and 4 will be the same
2294!
2295 if (scan(str1,':') .ne. 0) then
2296 marker=scan(str1,':')
2297 tmpstr(1)=str1(:marker-1)
2298 tmpstr(2)=str1(marker+1:)
2299 else
2300 tmpstr(1)=str1
2301 tmpstr(2)=str1
2302 end if
2303 if (scan(str2,':') .ne. 0) then
2304 marker=scan(str2,':')
2305 tmpstr(3)=str2(:marker-1)
2306 tmpstr(4)=str2(marker+1:)
2307 else
2308 tmpstr(3)=str2
2309 tmpstr(4)=str2
2310 end if
2311
2312! check format of substrings - (number followed by single character north/south east/west designation)
2313
2314 do i = 1,4
2315 tmplen(i)=len_trim(tmpstr(i))
2316 if (verify(tmpstr(i),"0123456789.").ne.tmplen(i) .or. verify(tmpstr(i)(tmplen(i):tmplen(i)),"eEwWnNsS") .ne. 0) then
2317 write(iulog,*)'GETLATIND (2): Improperly formatted column string. ',&
2318 inname,verify(tmpstr(i),"0123456789."),tmplen(i),&
2319 verify(tmpstr(i)(tmplen(i):tmplen(i)),"eEwWnNsS")
2320 call endrun
2321 end if
2322 end do
2323
2324! find latitude substrings and put into temporary work space tmpstr(1:2)
2325
2326 if (verify(tmpstr(1)(tmplen(1):tmplen(1)),"nNsSs").eq.0 .and. verify(tmpstr(2)(tmplen(2):tmplen(2)),"nNsSs").eq.0 ) then
2327
2328 else if (verify(tmpstr(3)(tmplen(3):tmplen(3)),"nNsSs").eq.0 .and. verify(tmpstr(3)(tmplen(3):tmplen(3)),"nNsSs").eq.0) then
2329 tmpstr(1) = tmpstr(3)
2330 tmplen(1)=tmplen(3)
2331 tmpstr(2) = tmpstr(4)
2332 tmplen(2)=tmplen(4)
2333 else
2334 call endrun ('GETLATIND (3): Improperly formatted column string. '//inname)
2335 end if
2336!
2337! convert lat substrings to real and if in southern hemisphere make negative
2338!
2339 do i = 1,2
2340 read(tmpstr(i)(1:tmplen(i)-1),*) latdegree(i)
2341 if (verify(tmpstr(i)(tmplen(i):tmplen(i)),'sS').eq.0) then
2342 latdegree(i)=(-1._r8)*latdegree(i)
2343 end if
2344!
2345! Make sure specified latitudes is in bounds
2346!
2347 if (latdegree(i) .lt. -90._r8 .or. latdegree(i) .gt. 90._r8) then
2348 write(iulog,*)'GETLATIND: latitude for column namelist is out of range (-90 .. 90) value=',latdegree(i)
2349 call endrun
2350 endif
2351!
2352! Find closest lat index for each substring
2353!
2354 latind(i)=mlat
2355 do j = 1, mlat-1
2356 if ( abs(latdeg(j)-latdegree(i)) .lt. &
2357 abs(latdeg(j+1)-latdegree(i))) then
2358 latind(i)=j
2359 exit
2360 endif
2361 enddo
2362 end do
2363!
2364! output begining and ending latitude indices. If just a column is specified then beginning latitude index will be the same as the
2365! ending latitude index
2366
2367!
2368 if (latind(1) .le. latind(2) ) then
2369 beglatind =latind(1)
2370 endlatind =latind(2)
2371 else
2372 beglatind = latind(2)
2373 endlatind = latind(1)
2374 end if
2375 if (beglatind .eq. endlatind) then
2376 latname = 'LAT_'//trim(tmpstr(1))
2377 else
2378 if (latind(1) .le. latind(2) ) then
2379 latname = 'LAT_'//trim(tmpstr(1)) // "_to_" // trim(tmpstr(2))
2380 else
2381 latname = 'LAT_'//trim(tmpstr(2)) // "_to_" // trim(tmpstr(1))
2382 end if
2383 end if
2384 ! one last sanity check
2385 if(scan(latname,' ') > 0) then
2386 latname(scan(latname,' '):) = ' '
2387 end if
2388
2389 return
2390 end subroutine getlatind
2391!#######################################################################
2392
2393 subroutine getlonind (inname,beglonind,endlonind,lonname,londeg,mlon)
2394!
2395!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2396!
2397! Purpose: retrieve closes model lat index given north south latitude string
2398!
2399! Method: If an averaging flag separater character is present (":") in inname,
2400! lop it off
2401!
2402!-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2403!
2404! Arguments
2405!
2406 character(len=*) inname,lonname
2407 integer :: beglonind,endlonind
2408 integer :: mlon
2409 real(r8) :: londeg(mlon)
2410!
2411! Local workspace
2412!
2413 character(len=max_chars) str1,str2,tmpstr(4)
2414 integer :: i,j,marker,lonind(2),tmplen(4)
2415 real(r8) :: londegree(2)
2416 real(r8) :: min, tmp
2417!
2418!-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2419!
2420 str1=' '
2421 str2=' '
2422 tmpstr(:)= ' '
2423!
2424! make sure _ separator is present
2425!
2426 if (scan(inname,'_').eq.0) then
2427 write(iulog,*)'GETLONIND: Improperly formatted column string. Missing underscore character (xxxE_yyyS) ',&
2428 inname,scan(inname,'_')
2429 call endrun
2430 end if
2431!
2432! split string in to lat lon strings
2433!
2434 marker=scan(inname,'_')
2435 str1=inname(:marker-1)
2436 str2=inname(marker+1:)
2437
2438!
2439! split ranges of lats( or lons) into seperate substrings. Substrings 1,2 will contain lats(lons)
2440! from portion of string before underscore
2441! if a single column and not a range is specified substrings 1 and 2 will be the same
2442! and substrings 3,4 will contain lats(lons) from portion of main string after underscore character
2443! if a single column and not a range is specified substrings 3 and 4 will be the same
2444!
2445 if (scan(str1,':') .ne. 0) then
2446 marker=scan(str1,':')
2447 tmpstr(1)=str1(:marker-1)
2448 tmpstr(2)=str1(marker+1:)
2449 else
2450 tmpstr(1)=str1
2451 tmpstr(2)=str1
2452 end if
2453
2454 if (scan(str2,':') .ne. 0) then
2455 marker=scan(str2,':')
2456 tmpstr(3)=str2(:marker-1)
2457 tmpstr(4)=str2(marker+1:)
2458 else
2459 tmpstr(3)=str2
2460 tmpstr(4)=str2
2461 end if
2462
2463! check format of substrings - (number followed by single character north/south east/west designation)
2464
2465 do i = 1,4
2466 tmplen(i)=len_trim(tmpstr(i))
2467 if (verify(tmpstr(i),"0123456789.").ne.tmplen(i) .or. verify(tmpstr(i)(tmplen(i):tmplen(i)),"eEwWnNsS") .ne. 0) then
2468 write(iulog,*)'GETLONIND (2): Improperly formatted column string. ', &
2469 inname,verify(tmpstr(i),"0123456789."),tmplen(i), &
2470 verify(tmpstr(i)(tmplen(i):tmplen(i)),"eEwWnNsS")
2471 call endrun
2472 end if
2473 end do
2474
2475! find longitude substrings and put into temporary work space tmpstr(1:2)
2476
2477 if (verify(tmpstr(1)(tmplen(1):tmplen(1)),"eEwW").eq.0 .and. verify(tmpstr(2)(tmplen(2):tmplen(2)),"eEwW").eq.0 ) then
2478
2479 else if (verify(tmpstr(3)(tmplen(3):tmplen(3)),"eEwW").eq.0 .and. verify(tmpstr(3)(tmplen(3):tmplen(3)),"eEwW").eq.0) then
2480 tmpstr(1) = tmpstr(3)
2481 tmplen(1)=tmplen(3)
2482 tmpstr(2) = tmpstr(4)
2483 tmplen(2)=tmplen(4)
2484 else
2485 call endrun ('GETLONIND (3): Improperly formatted column string. '//inname)
2486 end if
2487!
2488! convert lon substrings to real and make sure its degrees east
2489!
2490 do i = 1,2
2491 read(tmpstr(i)(1:tmplen(i)-1),*) londegree(i)
2492 if (verify(tmpstr(i)(tmplen(i):tmplen(i)),'wW').eq.0) then
2493 londegree(i) = 360._r8 - londegree(i)
2494 end if
2495!
2496! Make sure specified longitudes are in bounds
2497!
2498 if (londegree(i) .lt. 0._r8 .or. londegree(i) .gt. 360._r8) then
2499 write(iulog,*)'GETLONIND: longitude for column namelist is out of range (0 .. 360) value=',londegree(i)
2500 call endrun
2501 endif
2502!
2503! Find closest lon index for each substring. If just a column is specified then beginning longitude index will be the same as the
2504! ending longitude index
2505!
2506 min = 1.e+36_r8
2507 do j = 1, mlon
2508 tmp = abs(londeg(j)-londegree(i))
2509 if ( tmp .le. min) then
2510 min = tmp
2511 lonind(i) = j
2512 endif
2513 end do
2514 end do
2515!
2516! output begining and ending longitude indicies. If just a column is specified then beginning longitude index
2517! will be the same as the ending longitude index
2518!
2519 if (lonind(1) .le. lonind(2) ) then
2520 beglonind =lonind(1)
2521 endlonind =lonind(2)
2522 else
2523 beglonind = lonind(2)
2524 endlonind = lonind(1)
2525 end if
2526
2527
2528 if (beglonind .eq. endlonind) then
2529 lonname = 'LON_'//trim(tmpstr(1))
2530 else
2531 if (lonind(1) .le. lonind(2) ) then
2532 lonname = 'LON_'//trim(tmpstr(1)) // "_to_" // trim(tmpstr(2))
2533 else
2534 lonname = 'LON_'//trim(tmpstr(2)) // "_to_" // trim(tmpstr(1))
2535 end if
2536 end if
2537
2538
2539 return
2540 end subroutine getlonind

26188558489685584896 recursive subroutine outfld (fname, field, idim, c, avg_subcol_field)
2619 use cam_history_buffers, only: hbuf_accum_inst, hbuf_accum_add, &
2620 hbuf_accum_add00z, hbuf_accum_max, hbuf_accum_min, &
2621 hbuf_accum_addlcltime, dim_index_2d
2622 use subcol_utils, only: subcol_unpack
2623
2624 interface
2625 subroutine subcol_field_avg_handler(idim, field_in, c, field_out)
2626 use shr_kind_mod, only: r8 => shr_kind_r8
2627 integer, intent(in) :: idim
2628 real(r8), intent(in) :: field_in(idim, *)
2629 integer, intent(in) :: c
2630 real(r8), intent(out) :: field_out(:,:)
2631 end subroutine subcol_field_avg_handler
2632 end interface
2633
2634!
2635!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2636!
2637! Purpose: Accumulate (or take min, max, etc. as appropriate) input field
2638! into its history buffer for appropriate tapes
2639!
2640! Method: Check 'masterlist' whether the requested field 'fname' is active
2641! on one or more history tapes, and if so do the accumulation.
2642! If not found, return silently.
2643! subcol_field_avg_handler:
2644! An interface into subcol_field_avg without creating a dependency as
2645! this would cause a dependency loop. See subcol.F90
2646! Note: We cannot know a priori if field is a grid average field or a subcolumn
2647! field because many fields passed to outfld are defined on ncol rather
2648! than pcols or psetcols. Therefore, we use the avg_subcol_field input
2649! to determine whether to average the field input before accumulation.
2650! NB: If output is on a subcolumn grid (requested in addfle), it is
2651! an error to use avg_subcol_field. A subcolumn field is assumed and
2652! subcol_unpack is called before accumulation.
2653!
2654! Author: CCM Core Group
2655!
2656!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2657!
2658! Arguments
2659!
2660 character(len=*), intent(in) :: fname ! Field name--should be 8 chars
2661
2662 ! For structured grids, idim is the local longitude dimension.
2663 ! For unstructured grids, idim is the local column dimension
2664 ! For phys_decomp, it should be pcols or pcols*psubcols
2665 integer, intent(in) :: idim
2666 real(r8), intent(in) :: field(idim,*) ! Field values
2667 integer, intent(in) :: c ! chunk (physics) or latitude (dynamics) index
2668 logical, optional, intent(in) :: avg_subcol_field
2669
2670!
2671! Local variables
2672!
2673 integer :: t, f ! tape, field indices
2674 integer :: begdim1 ! on-node dim1 start index
2675 integer :: enddim1 ! on-node dim1 end index
2676 integer :: begdim2 ! on-node dim2 start index
2677 integer :: enddim2 ! on-node dim2 end index
2678 integer :: endi ! ending longitude index (reduced grid)
2679 integer :: i, j ! Loop indices
2680
2681 character*1 :: avgflag ! averaging flag
2682
2683 real(r8), pointer :: hbuf(:,:) ! history buffer
2684 integer, pointer :: nacs(:) ! accumulation counter
2685 type (dim_index_2d) :: dimind ! 2-D dimension index
2686 logical :: flag_xyfill ! non-applicable xy points flagged with fillvalue
2687 real(r8) :: fillvalue
2688 real(r8), allocatable :: afield(:,:) ! Averaged field values
2689 real(r8), allocatable :: ufield(:,:,:) ! Unpacked field values
2690 integer :: ff ! masterlist index pointer
2691 integer :: ierr, ncol
2692 logical :: found
2693 logical :: avg_subcols ! average subcols before accum
2694!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2695
269685584896171169792 call get_field_properties (fname, found, tape_out=tape, ff_out=ff, &
2697 flag_xyfill_out=flag_xyfill, fillvalue_out=fillvalue, &
2698 begdim1_out=begdim1, enddim1_out=enddim1, &
2699 begdim2_out=begdim2, enddim2_out=enddim2)
2700
2701 ! If this field is not active, return now
27028558489685584896 if (.not. found) then
2703 return
2704 end if
2705
2706!
2707! Note, the field may be on any or all of the history files (primary
2708! and auxiliary).
2709!
2710! write(iulog,*)'fname_loc=',fname_loc
2711106156032115002368 do 40 t = 1, ptapes
2712106156032106156032 if ( .not. masterlist(ff)%thisentry%actflag(t)) cycle
271388463368846336 f = masterlist(ff)%thisentry%htapeindx(t)
2714!
2715! Update history buffer
2716!
2717 avgflag = tape(t)%hlist(f)%avgflag
2718
271988463368846336 nacs => tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs(:,c)
2720
2721
2722884633617692672 hbuf => tape(t)%hlist(f)%hbuf(:,:,c)
2723
2724884633626539008 if(associated(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%colperdim3)) then
272588463368846336 endi = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%colperdim3(c)
2726 else
272700 endi = enddim1 - begdim1 + 1
2728 end if
272988463368846336 dimind = dim_index_2d (1,endi,begdim2,enddim2)
2730
2731 ! See notes above about validity of avg_subcol_field
2732 if (tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%is_subcol) then
273300 if (present(avg_subcol_field)) then
273400 call endrun('OUTFLD: Cannot average '//trim(fname)//', subcolumn output was requested in addfld')
2735 end if
273600 avg_subcols = .false.
273788463368846336 else if (tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%decomp_type == phys_decomp) then
2738884633626539008 if (present(avg_subcol_field)) then
2739372736372736 avg_subcols = avg_subcol_field
2740 else
274184736008473600 avg_subcols = .false.
2742 end if
2743 else ! Any dynamics decomposition
274400 if (present(avg_subcol_field)) then
274500 call endrun('OUTFLD: avg_subcol_field only valid for phys_decomp')
2746 else
274700 avg_subcols = .false.
2748 end if
2749 end if
2750
275188463368846336 if (avg_subcols) then
275200 allocate(afield(pcols, begdim2:enddim2))
275300 call subcol_field_avg_handler(idim, field, c, afield)
2754 ! Hack! Avoid duplicating select statement below
275500 call outfld(fname, afield, pcols, c)
275600 deallocate(afield)
275788463368846336 else if (tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%is_subcol) then
2758 ! We have to assume that using mdimnames (e.g., psubcols) is
2759 ! incompatible with the begdimx, enddimx usage (checked in addfld)
2760 ! Since psubcols is included in levels, take that out
276100 endi = (enddim2 - begdim2 + 1) / psubcols
276200 allocate(ufield(pcols, psubcols, endi))
276300 allocate(afield(pcols*psubcols, endi))
276400 do j = 1, endi
276500 do i = 1, idim
2766 afield(i, j) = field(i, j)
2767 end do
2768 end do
2769 ! Initialize unused aray locations.
277000 if (idim < pcols*psubcols) then
277100 if (flag_xyfill) then
277200 afield(idim+1:pcols*psubcols, :) = fillvalue
2773 else
277400 afield(idim+1:pcols*psubcols, :) = 0.0_r8
2775 end if
2776 end if
277700 if (flag_xyfill) then
277800 call subcol_unpack(c, afield, ufield, fillvalue)
2779 else
278000 call subcol_unpack(c, afield, ufield)
2781 end if
278200 deallocate(afield)
278300 select case (avgflag)
2784
278500 case ('I') ! Instantaneous
278600 call hbuf_accum_inst(hbuf, ufield, nacs, dimind, pcols, &
2787 flag_xyfill, fillvalue)
2788
278900 case ('A') ! Time average
279000 call hbuf_accum_add(hbuf, ufield, nacs, dimind, pcols, &
2791 flag_xyfill, fillvalue)
2792
279300 case ('B') ! Time average only 00z values
279400 call hbuf_accum_add00z(hbuf, ufield, nacs, dimind, pcols, &
2795 flag_xyfill, fillvalue)
2796
279700 case ('X') ! Maximum over time
279800 call hbuf_accum_max (hbuf, ufield, nacs, dimind, pcols, &
2799 flag_xyfill, fillvalue)
2800
280100 case ('M') ! Minimum over time
280200 call hbuf_accum_min(hbuf, ufield, nacs, dimind, pcols, &
2803 flag_xyfill, fillvalue)
2804
280500 case ('L')
280600 call hbuf_accum_addlcltime(hbuf, field, nacs, dimind, pcols, &
2807 flag_xyfill, fillvalue, c, &
2808 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%decomp_type, &
2809 lcltod_start(t), lcltod_stop(t))
2810
2811 case default
281200 call endrun ('OUTFLD: invalid avgflag='//avgflag)
2813
2814 end select
281500 deallocate(ufield)
2816 else
2817884633626539008 select case (avgflag)
2818
28195324853248 case ('I') ! Instantaneous
28205324853248 call hbuf_accum_inst(hbuf, field, nacs, dimind, idim, &
2821 flag_xyfill, fillvalue)
2822
282386886408688640 case ('A') ! Time average
282486886408688640 call hbuf_accum_add(hbuf, field, nacs, dimind, idim, &
2825 flag_xyfill, fillvalue)
2826
282700 case ('B') ! Time average only 00z values
282800 call hbuf_accum_add00z(hbuf, field, nacs, dimind, idim, &
2829 flag_xyfill, fillvalue)
2830
28315222452224 case ('X') ! Maximum over time
28325222452224 call hbuf_accum_max (hbuf, field, nacs, dimind, idim, &
2833 flag_xyfill, fillvalue)
2834
28355222452224 case ('M') ! Minimum over time
28365222452224 call hbuf_accum_min(hbuf, field, nacs, dimind, idim, &
2837 flag_xyfill, fillvalue)
2838
283900 case ('L')
284000 call hbuf_accum_addlcltime(hbuf, field, nacs, dimind, idim, &
2841 flag_xyfill, fillvalue, c, &
2842 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%decomp_type, &
2843 lcltod_start(t), lcltod_stop(t))
2844
2845 case default
284600 call endrun ('OUTFLD: invalid avgflag='//avgflag)
2847
2848 end select
2849 end if
285040 continue
2851
2852 return
285385584896256754688 end subroutine outfld

2856
28578558489685584896 subroutine get_field_properties (fname, found, tape_out, ff_out, nlev_out, &
2858 flag_xyfill_out, fillvalue_out, mdims_out, begdim1_out, enddim1_out, &
2859 begdim2_out, enddim2_out, begdim3_out, enddim3_out)
2860
2861 implicit none
2862!
2863!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2864!
2865! Purpose: If fname is active, lookup and return field information
2866!
2867! Method: Check 'masterlist' whether the requested field 'fname' is active
2868! on one or more history tapes, and if so, return the requested
2869! field information
2870!
2871! Author: goldy
2872!
2873!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2874!
2875! Arguments
2876!
2877 character(len=*), intent(in) :: fname ! Field name--should be 8 chars long
2878 logical, intent(out) :: found ! Set to true if fname is active
2879 type(active_entry), optional, pointer :: tape_out(:)
2880 integer, optional, intent(out) :: ff_out
2881 integer, optional, intent(out) :: nlev_out
2882 logical, optional, intent(out) :: flag_xyfill_out
2883 real(r8), optional, intent(out) :: fillvalue_out
2884 integer, optional, pointer :: mdims_out(:)
2885 integer, optional, intent(out) :: begdim1_out
2886 integer, optional, intent(out) :: enddim1_out
2887 integer, optional, intent(out) :: begdim2_out
2888 integer, optional, intent(out) :: enddim2_out
2889 integer, optional, intent(out) :: begdim3_out
2890 integer, optional, intent(out) :: enddim3_out
2891
2892!
2893! Local variables
2894!
2895 type (active_entry), pointer :: tape(:)
2896 character*(max_fieldname_len) :: fname_loc ! max-char equivalent of fname
2897 integer :: t, f, ff ! tape, field, masterindex indices
2898 integer :: ierr
2899!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
2900
2901 tape => history_tape
2902
2903 ! Need to re-cast the field name so that the hashing works #hackalert
29048558489685584896 fname_loc = fname
290585584896171169792 ff = get_masterlist_indx(fname_loc)
2906
2907! Set found to .false. so we can return early if fname is not active
2908 found = .false.
2909
2910!
2911! If ( ff < 0 ), the field is not defined on the masterlist. This check
2912! is necessary because of coding errors calling outfld without first defining
2913! the field on masterlist.
2914!
2915 if ( ff < 0 ) then
2916 return
2917 end if
2918!
2919! Next, check to see whether this field is active on one or more history
2920! tapes.
2921!
29228558489685584896 if ( .not. masterlist(ff)%thisentry%act_sometape ) then
2923 return
2924 end if
2925!
2926! Note, the field may be on any or all of the history files (primary
2927! and auxiliary).
2928!
2929
293088463368846336 do t=1, ptapes
293188463368846336 if (masterlist(ff)%thisentry%actflag(t)) then
293288463368846336 f = masterlist(ff)%thisentry%htapeindx(t)
2933 found = .true.
2934
2935884633617692672 if (present(tape_out)) then
293688463368846336 tape_out => tape
2937 end if
2938884633626539008 if (present(ff_out)) then
293988463368846336 ff_out = ff
2940 end if
2941884633626539008 if (present(nlev_out)) then
294200 nlev_out = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%numlev
2943 end if
2944884633626539008 if (present(flag_xyfill_out)) then
294588463368846336 flag_xyfill_out = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%flag_xyfill
2946 end if
2947884633626539008 if (present(fillvalue_out)) then
294888463368846336 fillvalue_out = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%fillvalue
2949 end if
2950884633626539008 if (present(mdims_out)) then
295100 if (associated(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%mdims)) then
295200 mdims_out => tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%mdims
2953 else
295400 nullify(mdims_out)
2955 end if
2956 end if
2957884633626539008 if (present(begdim1_out)) then
295888463368846336 begdim1_out = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim1
2959 end if
2960884633626539008 if (present(enddim1_out)) then
296188463368846336 enddim1_out = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim1
2962 end if
2963884633626539008 if (present(begdim2_out)) then
296488463368846336 begdim2_out = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim2
2965 end if
2966884633626539008 if (present(enddim2_out)) then
296788463368846336 enddim2_out = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim2
2968 end if
2969884633626539008 if (present(begdim3_out)) then
297000 begdim3_out = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim3
2971 end if
2972884633626539008 if (present(enddim3_out)) then
297300 enddim3_out = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim3
2974 end if
2975 ! We found the info so we are done with the loop
2976 exit
2977 end if
2978 end do
2979
29808558489685584896 end subroutine get_field_properties
2981

29842469478724694787 logical function is_initfile (file_index)
2985!
2986!------------------------------------------------------------------------
2987!
2988! Purpose: to determine:
2989!
2990! a) if an IC file is active in this model run at all
2991! OR,
2992! b) if it is active, is the current file index referencing the IC file
2993! (IC file is always at ptapes)
2994!
2995!------------------------------------------------------------------------
2996!
2997! Arguments
2998!
2999 integer, intent(in), optional :: file_index ! index of file in question
3000
30012469478724694787 is_initfile = .false.
3002
30032469478749389574 if (present(file_index)) then
30042458829151275783 if (inithist /= 'NONE' .and. file_index == ptapes) is_initfile = .true.
3005 else
3006106496212992 if (inithist /= 'NONE' ) is_initfile = .true.
3007 end if
3008
3009 return
3010
30112469478724694787 end function is_initfile

3015 integer function strcmpf (name1, name2)
3016!
3017!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3018!
3019! Purpose: Return the lexical difference between two strings
3020!
3021! Method: Use ichar() intrinsic as we loop through the names
3022!
3023!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3024!
3025! Arguments
3026!
3027 character(len=max_fieldname_len), intent(in) :: name1, name2 ! strings to compare
3028 integer n ! loop index
3029
3030 do n=1,max_fieldname_len
3031 strcmpf = ichar(name1(n:n)) - ichar(name2(n:n))
3032 if (strcmpf /= 0) exit
3033 end do
3034
3035 return
3036 end function strcmpf

3040 subroutine h_inquire (t)
3041 use pio, only : pio_inquire, pio_inq_dimid, pio_inquire_dimension, pio_inq_varid, &
3042 pio_inquire_variable, pio_inq_attlen
3043 use dycore, only : dycore_is
3044!
3045!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3046!
3047! Purpose: Ensure that the proper variables are on a history file
3048!
3049! Method: Issue the appropriate netcdf wrapper calls
3050!
3051!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3052!
3053! Arguments
3054!
3055 integer, intent(in) :: t ! tape index
3056!
3057! Local workspace
3058!
3059 integer f,ff ! field index
3060 integer ret ! return value from function call
3061
3062
3063 integer :: ierr
3064 integer :: len
3065 integer(pio_offset_kind) :: mdimsize
3066
3067!
3068!
3069! Dimension id's
3070!
3071 tape => history_tape
3072
3073
3074
3075!
3076! Create variables for model timing and header information
3077!
3078 if(.not. is_satfile(t)) then
3079 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,'ndcur ', tape(t)%ndcurid)
3080 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,'nscur ', tape(t)%nscurid)
3081 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,'nsteph ', tape(t)%nstephid)
3082
3083 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,'time_bnds', tape(t)%tbndid)
3084 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,'date_written',tape(t)%date_writtenid)
3085 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,'time_written',tape(t)%time_writtenid)
3086#if ( defined BFB_CAM_SCAM_IOP )
3087 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,'tsec ',tape(t)%tsecid)
3088 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,'bdate ',tape(t)%bdateid)
3089#endif
3090 if (.not. is_initfile(file_index=t) ) then
3091 ! Don't write the GHG/Solar forcing data to the IC file. It is never
3092 ! read from that file so it's confusing to have it there.
3093 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,'co2vmr ', tape(t)%co2vmrid)
3094 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,'ch4vmr ', tape(t)%ch4vmrid)
3095 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,'n2ovmr ', tape(t)%n2ovmrid)
3096 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,'f11vmr ', tape(t)%f11vmrid)
3097 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,'f12vmr ', tape(t)%f12vmrid)
3098 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,'sol_tsi ', tape(t)%sol_tsiid)
3099 if (solar_parms_on) then
3100 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,'f107 ', tape(t)%f107id)
3101 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,'f107a ', tape(t)%f107aid)
3102 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,'kp ', tape(t)%kpid)
3103 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,'ap ', tape(t)%apid)
3104 endif
3105 end if
3106 end if
3107 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,'date ', tape(t)%dateid)
3108 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,'datesec ', tape(t)%datesecid)
3109 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,'time ', tape(t)%timeid)
3110
3111
3112!
3113! Obtain variable name from ID which was read from restart file
3114!
3115 do f=1,nflds(t)
3116 if(.not.associated(tape(t)%hlist(f)%varid)) then
3117 allocate(tape(t)%hlist(f)%varid(max(1,ngroup(t))))
3118 end if
3119!
3120! If this field will be put out as columns then get column names for field
3121!
3122 if (ngroup(t) .gt. 0) then
3123 do i=1,ngroup(t)
3124 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File, tape(t)%hlist(f)%field_column_name(i), tape(t)%hlist(f)%varid(i))
3125 ierr=pio_get_att(tape(t)%File, tape(t)%hlist(f)%varid(i), 'basename',tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%name)
3126 end do
3127 else
3128 ierr=pio_inq_varid (tape(t)%File,tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%name, tape(t)%hlist(f)%varid(1))
3129 end if
3130 if(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%numlev>1) then
3131 ierr = pio_inq_attlen(tape(t)%File,tape(t)%hlist(f)%varid(1),'mdims', mdimsize)
3132 if(.not. associated(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%mdims)) then
3133 allocate(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%mdims(mdimsize))
3134 end if
3135 ierr=pio_get_att(tape(t)%File,tape(t)%hlist(f)%varid(1),'mdims', &
3136 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%mdims(1:mdimsize))
3137 if(mdimsize>maxvarmdims) maxvarmdims=mdimsize
3138 end if
3139
3140 end do
3141
3142 if(masterproc) then
3143 write(iulog,*)'H_INQUIRE: Successfully opened netcdf file '
3144 end if
3145
3146 return
3147 end subroutine h_inquire

3151125440125440 subroutine add_default (name, tindex, flag)
3152!
3153!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3154!
3155! Purpose: Add a field to the default "on" list for a given history file
3156!
3157! Method:
3158!
3159!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3160!
3161! Arguments
3162!
3163 character(len=*), intent(in) :: name ! field name
3164 character(len=1), intent(in) :: flag ! averaging flag
3165
3166 integer, intent(in) :: tindex ! history tape index
3167!
3168! Local workspace
3169!
3170 integer :: t ! file index
3171 integer :: f ! field index
3172 type(master_entry), pointer :: listentry
3173
3174125440125440 if (htapes_defined) then
317500 call endrun ('ADD_DEFAULT: Attempt to add hist default '//trim(name)//' after history files set')
3176 end if
3177!
3178! Check validity of input arguments
3179!
3180125440125440 if (tindex > ptapes) then
318100 write(iulog,*)'ADD_DEFAULT: tape index=', tindex, ' is too big'
318200 call endrun
3183 end if
3184
3185! Add to IC file if tindex = 0, reset to ptapes
3186125440125440 if (tindex == 0) then
31873123231232 t = ptapes
31883123262464 if ( .not. is_initfile(file_index=t) ) return
3189 else
31909420894208 t = tindex
3191 end if
3192
3193125440219136 if (flag /= ' ' .and. flag /= 'A' .and. flag /= 'B' .and. flag /= 'I' .and. &
319400 flag /= 'X' .and. flag /= 'M' .and. flag /= 'L') then
3195
319600 call endrun ('ADD_DEFAULT: unknown averaging flag='//flag)
3197 end if
3198!
3199! Look through master list for input field name. When found, set active
3200! flag for that tape to true. Also set averaging flag if told to use other
3201! than default.
3202!
3203125440752640 listentry => get_entry_by_name(masterlinkedlist, trim(name))
3204125440250880 if(.not.associated(listentry)) then
320500 call endrun ('ADD_DEFAULT: field='//name//' not found')
3206 end if
3207125440125440 listentry%actflag(t) = .true.
3208 if (flag /= ' ') then
32093123231232 listentry%avgflag(t) = flag
32103123293696 select case (flag)
321100 case ('A')
321200 listentry%time_op(t) = 'mean'
321300 case ('B')
321400 listentry%time_op(t) = 'mean00z'
32153123231232 case ('I')
32163123231232 listentry%time_op(t) = ' '
321700 case ('X')
321800 listentry%time_op(t) = 'maximum'
321900 case ('M')
322000 listentry%time_op(t) = 'minimum'
322100 case ('L')
322200 listentry%time_op(t) = LT_DESC
3223 case default
322400 call endrun ('ADD_DEFAULT: unknown avgflag='//flag)
3225 end select
3226 end if
3227
3228 return
3229125440125440 end subroutine add_default

3233 subroutine h_override (t)
3234!
3235!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3236!
3237! Purpose: Override default history tape contents for a specific tape
3238!
3239! Method: Copy the flag into the master field list

3247! Local workspace

3250

3252
3253
3254 avgflg = avgflag_pertape(t)
3255
3256
3257 listentry=>masterlinkedlist

3260 select case (avgflg)

3265 case ('I')

3284512512 subroutine h_define (t, restart)
3285 !
3286 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3287 !
3288 ! Purpose: Define contents of history file t
3289 !
3290 ! Method: Issue the required netcdf wrapper calls to define the history file contents
3291 !
3292 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3293 use pspect, only: ptrn, ptrk, ptrm
3294 use rgrid, only: nlon, wnummax
3295
3296 use dyn_grid, only: get_dyn_grid_parm_real2d, get_dyn_grid_parm_real1d
3297 use dycore, only: dycore_is

3299 use filenames, only: caseid
3300 use string_utils, only: to_upper
3301 use cam_abortutils, only: endrun
3302 use dycore, only: dycore_is
3303 use physconst, only: pi

3305 use cam_pio_utils, only: cam_pio_createfile, get_phys_decomp
3306 use interp_mod, only: get_interp_lat, get_interp_lon, latlon_interpolation, add_interp_attributes
3307 use sat_hist, only: sat_hist_define
3308
3309 use ppgrid, only : begchunk,endchunk, pver, pverp
3310 use phys_grid, only : get_rlat_all_p, get_rlon_all_p
3311
3312 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
3313
3314 !
3315 ! Input arguments
3316 !
3317 integer, intent(in) :: t ! tape index
3318 logical, intent(in) :: restart
3319 !
3320 ! Local workspace
3321 !
3322 integer :: i, j ! longitude, latitude indices
3323 integer :: f ! field index
3324 integer :: ff ! varid index for fields output by column
3325 integer :: numlev ! number of vertical levels (dimension and loop)
3326 integer :: ncreal ! real data type for output
3327 integer :: dtime ! timestep size
3328 integer :: ndbase = 0 ! days component of base time
3329 integer :: nsbase = 0 ! seconds component of base time
3330 integer :: nbdate ! base date in yyyymmdd format
3331 integer :: bdate ! base date in yyyymmdd format
3332 integer :: nbsec ! time of day component of base date [seconds]
3333 integer :: yr, mon, day ! year, month, day components of a date
3334
3335
3336 integer :: slatdim ! staggered latitude dimension
3337 integer :: slondim ! staggered longitude dimension
3338 type(var_desc_t) :: slatvar ! variable id for staggered lat
3339 type(var_desc_t) :: slonvar ! variable id for staggered lon
3340 type(var_desc_t) :: wsid ! Staggered latitude weight ID
3341
3342 real(r8), pointer:: londeg_st(:,:) ! Staggered grid point array (lon)
3343 real(r8), pointer:: latdeg_st(: ) ! Staggered grid point array (lat)
3344 real(r8), pointer:: w_staggered(:) ! Staggered location weights
3345
3346 real(r8), pointer :: latdeg(:) ! degrees gaussian latitudes
3347 real(r8), pointer :: latdeg2d(:,:) ! degrees latitudes for ncols
3348 real(r8), pointer :: londeg(:,:) ! degrees longitude
3349 real(r8), pointer :: w(:) ! grid weights

4117 subroutine h_normalize (f, t)
4118
4119 use dycore, only: dycore_is
4120
4121!
4122!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4123!
4124! Purpose: Normalize fields on a history file by the number of accumulations
4125!
4126! Method: Loop over fields on the tape. Need averaging flag and number of
4127! accumulations to perform normalization.
4128!
4129!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4130!
4131! Input arguments
4132!
4133 integer, intent(in) :: f ! field index
4134 integer, intent(in) :: t ! tape index
4135!
4136! Local workspace
4137!
4138 integer begdim2 ! on-node vert start index
4139 integer enddim2 ! on-node vert end index
4140 integer c ! chunk (or lat) index
4141 integer endi ! terminating column index
4142 integer begdim1 ! on-node dim1 start index
4143 integer enddim1 ! on-node dim1 end index
4144 integer begdim3 ! on-node chunk or lat start index
4145 integer enddim3 ! on-node chunk or lat end index
4146 integer :: ib, ie ! beginning and ending indices of first dimension
4147 integer :: jb, je ! beginning and ending indices of second dimension
4148 integer k
4149
4150 logical :: flag_xyfill ! non-applicable xy points flagged with fillvalue
4151 character*1 avgflag ! averaging flag
4152
4153 call t_startf ('h_normalize')
4154
4155 begdim2 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim2
4156 enddim2 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim2
4157 avgflag = tape(t)%hlist(f)%avgflag
4158!
4159! normalize by number of accumulations for averaged case
4160!
4161 begdim1 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim1
4162 enddim1 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim1
4163 begdim3 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim3
4164 enddim3 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim3
4165 flag_xyfill = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%flag_xyfill
4166 do c=begdim3,enddim3
4167 ! Some slices might not be entirely full -- use endi instead of enddim2
4168 if(associated(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%colperdim3)) then
4169 endi = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%colperdim3(c)
4170 else
4171 endi = enddim1-begdim1+1
4172 end if
4173
4174 ib = begdim1
4175 ie = begdim1+endi-1
4176 jb = begdim2
4177 je = enddim2
4178
4179 if (flag_xyfill) then
4180 do k=jb,je
4181 where (tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs(ib:ie,c) == 0)
4182 tape(t)%hlist(f)%hbuf(ib:ie,k,c) = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%fillvalue
4183 endwhere
4184 end do
4185 end if
4186
4187 if (avgflag == 'A' .or. avgflag == 'B' .or. avgflag == 'L') then
4188 if(flag_xyfill .or. avgflag == 'L') then
4189 do k=jb,je
4190 where (tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs(ib:ie,c) /= 0)
4191 tape(t)%hlist(f)%hbuf(ib:ie,k,c) = &
4192 tape(t)%hlist(f)%hbuf(ib:ie,k,c) &
4193 / tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs(ib:ie,c)
4194 endwhere
4195 end do
4196 else if(tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs(1,c) > 0) then
4197 do k=jb,je
4198 tape(t)%hlist(f)%hbuf(ib:ie,k,c) = &
4199 tape(t)%hlist(f)%hbuf(ib:ie,k,c) &
4200 / tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs(1,c)
4201 end do
4202 end if
4203 end if
4204 end do
4205
4206 call t_stopf ('h_normalize')
4207
4208 return
4209 end subroutine h_normalize

4213 subroutine h_zero (f, t)
4214 use dycore, only: dycore_is
4215!
4216!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4217!
4218! Purpose: Zero out accumulation buffers for a tape
4219!
4220! Method: Loop through fields on the tape
4221!
4222!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4223!
4224 integer, intent(in) :: f ! field index
4225 integer, intent(in) :: t ! tape index
4226!
4227! Local workspace
4228!
4229 integer begdim1 ! on-node 1st dim start index
4230 integer enddim1 ! on-node 1st dim end index
4231 integer begdim2 ! on-node vert start index
4232 integer enddim2 ! on-node vert end index
4233 integer c ! chunk index
4234 integer endi ! terminating column index
4235 integer begdim3 ! on-node chunk or lat start index
4236 integer enddim3 ! on-node chunk or lat end index
4237 type (dim_index_3d) :: dimind ! 3-D dimension index
4238
4239 call t_startf ('h_zero')
4240
4241 begdim1 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim1
4242 enddim1 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim1
4243 begdim2 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim2
4244 enddim2 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim2
4245 begdim3 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim3
4246 enddim3 = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim3
4247
4248 if(associated(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%colperdim3)) then
4249 do c=begdim3,enddim3
4250 endi = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%colperdim3(c)
4251 tape(t)%hlist(f)%hbuf(begdim1:begdim1+endi-1,begdim2:enddim2,c)=0._r8
4252 end do
4253 tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs(:,:) = 0
4254 else
4255 endi = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim1 - tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim1 + 1
4256 tape(t)%hlist(f)%hbuf(begdim1:begdim1+endi-1,begdim2:enddim2,begdim3:enddim3)=0._r8
4257 tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs(:,:) = 0
4258 end if
4259
4260 call t_stopf ('h_zero')
4261
4262 return
4263 end subroutine h_zero
