42679420894208 subroutine dump_field (f, t, restart)
4268 use interp_mod, only: latlon_interpolation
4269 use cam_pio_utils, only: get_decomp, pio_subsystem
4270 use dycore, only: dycore_is
4271 use interp_mod, only : write_interpolated
4272 use spmd_utils, only : iam
4273 integer, intent(in) :: f, t
4274 logical, intent(in) :: restart
4275!
4276!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4277!
4278! Purpose: Write a variable to a history tape
4279!
4280! Method: If SPMD, first gather the data to the master processor.
4281! Next, transpose the data to COORDS order (the default).
4282! Finally, issue the netcdf call to write the variable
4283!
4284!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4285 integer :: bsize, ierr
4286
4287 real(r4), allocatable :: localbuf4(:)
4288 type(io_desc_t), pointer :: int_iodesc, iodesc
4289 type(var_desc_t), pointer :: varid, varid_vecv
4290 character(len=max_fieldname_len) :: fname
4291 type(column_info) :: tmpcolumn
4292 integer :: ff
4293
429494208188416 interpolate = (latlon_interpolation(t) .and. .not. restart )
42959420894208 do i=1,max(ngroup(t),1)
429694208188416 if(restart .and. i>1) exit
42979420894208 varid=>tape(t)%hlist(f)%varid(i)
4298
4299 if(restart) then
43009420894208 call pio_setframe(tape(t)%File,varid, int(-1,kind=pio_offset_kind))
43019420894208 if(.not. interpolate) then
43029420894208 call get_decomp(iodesc, tape(t)%hlist(f)%field, pio_double)
4303 end if
4304 else
430500 call pio_setframe(tape(t)%File,varid, int(max(1,nfils(t)),kind=pio_offset_kind))
430600 if(ngroup(t)>0) then
430700 tmpcolumn = tape(t)%column(i)
4308 nullify(tmpcolumn%hmask)
430900 if(dycore_is('LR')) then
431000 fname = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%name
431100 if(fname .eq. 'US' .or. fname .eq. 'FU_S') then
431200 tmpcolumn%columnlat(1) = tape(t)%column_st(i)%columnlat(1)+1
4313 ! Adding 1 because staggered lat indexing for "xzybuf" starts at 2
4314 tmpcolumn%columnlat(2) = tape(t)%column_st(i)%columnlat(2)+1
4315 tmpcolumn%num_lats = tape(t)%column_st(i)%num_lats
431600 else if(fname .eq. 'VS' .or. fname .eq. 'FV_S') then
431700 tmpcolumn%columnlon = tape(t)%column_st(i)%columnlon
431800 tmpcolumn%num_lons = tape(t)%column_st(i)%num_lons
4319 end if
4320 end if
432100 allocate(iodesc) ! no lookup table for columns
432200 call get_decomp(iodesc, tape(t)%hlist(f)%field, pio_double,column=tmpcolumn)
4323
4324#ifdef HDEBUG
4325 write(iulog,*)'DUMP_FIELD:',__LINE__,' writing column time indx ', &
4326 nfils(t), ' field id', tape(t)%hlist(f)%varid(i)%varid, &
4327 ' name ', trim(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field_column_name(i)), &
4328 'numlons=',tmpcolumn%num_lons,'numlats=', tmpcolumn%num_lats, ' base name ', &
4329 trim(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%name),' columnlon=', &
4330 tmpcolumn%columnlon, ' columnlat=', tmpcolumn%columnlat
4331#endif
433200 else if(associated(tape(t)%column(1)%hmask)) then
433300 call get_decomp(iodesc, tape(t)%hlist(f)%field, pio_double, column=tape(t)%column(1))
433400 else if(.not. interpolate) then
433500 call get_decomp(iodesc, tape(t)%hlist(f)%field, pio_double)
4336 endif
4337 end if
4338
4339
43409420894208 bsize=size(tape(t)%hlist(f)%hbuf)
4341 if(interpolate) then
434200 ff = tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%vector_compliment
4343 ! ff < 0 is the vector compliment of ff*(-1)
4344 if(ff > 0) then
434500 varid_vecv=>tape(t)%hlist(ff)%varid(i)
4346 if(.not.restart) then
434700 call pio_setframe(tape(t)%File,varid_vecv, int(max(1,nfils(t)),kind=pio_offset_kind))
4348 endif
434900 call write_interpolated(tape(t)%File, varid, varid_vecv, tape(t)%hlist(f)%hbuf,&
4350 tape(t)%hlist(ff)%hbuf, tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%numlev, pio_double, tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%decomp_type)
435100 else if(ff==0) then
435200 call write_interpolated(tape(t)%File, varid, tape(t)%hlist(f)%hbuf,&
4353 tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%numlev, pio_double, tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%decomp_type)
4354 endif
4355 else
435694208215552 if(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%numlev>1 .and. .not. associated(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%mdims)) then
435700 call endrun('mdims not defined for variable '//trim(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%name))
4358 end if
43599420894208 call pio_write_darray(tape(t)%File, varid, iodesc, tape(t)%hlist(f)%hbuf, ierr)
4360 endif
4361
43629420894208 if(restart) then
436394208181760 if(tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%flag_xyfill .or. (avgflag_pertape(t) == 'L')) then
436466566656 call get_decomp(int_iodesc, tape(t)%hlist(f)%field, pio_int, 1)
436566566656 call pio_write_darray(tape(t)%File, tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs_varid, &
4366 int_iodesc, tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs, ierr)
4367
4368 else
436987552262656 ierr = pio_put_var(tape(t)%File, tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs_varid,&
4370 tape(t)%hlist(f)%nacs(:, tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%begdim3:tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%enddim3))
4371 end if
4372 end if
43739420894208 if(.not. restart .and. ngroup(t)>0) then
437400 call pio_freedecomp(pio_subsystem, iodesc)
437500 deallocate(iodesc) ! no lookup table for columns
4376 end if
4377
4378 end do
4379
4380 return
438194208188416 end subroutine dump_field

4385105984105984 logical function write_inithist ()
4386!
4387!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4388!
4389! Purpose: Set flags that will initiate dump to IC file when OUTFLD and
4390! WSHIST are called
4391!
4392!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4393!
4394 use time_manager, only: get_nstep, get_curr_date, get_step_size, is_last_step
4395!
4396! Local workspace
4397!
4398 integer :: yr, mon, day ! year, month, and day components of
4399 ! a date
4400 integer :: nstep ! current timestep number
4401 integer :: ncsec ! current time of day [seconds]
4402 integer :: dtime ! timestep size
4403
4404!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4405
4406105984105984 write_inithist = .false.
4407
4408105984211968 if(is_initfile()) then
4409
4410105984211968 nstep = get_nstep()
4411105984105984 call get_curr_date(yr, mon, day, ncsec)
4412
4413105984105984 if (inithist == '6-HOURLY') then
441400 dtime = get_step_size()
441500 write_inithist = nstep /= 0 .and. mod( nstep, nint((6._r8*3600._r8)/dtime) ) == 0
4416105984105984 elseif(inithist == 'DAILY' ) then
441700 write_inithist = nstep /= 0 .and. ncsec == 0
4418105984105984 elseif(inithist == 'MONTHLY' ) then
441900 write_inithist = nstep /= 0 .and. ncsec == 0 .and. day == 1
4420105984105984 elseif(inithist == 'YEARLY' ) then
4421105984953856 write_inithist = nstep /= 0 .and. ncsec == 0 .and. day == 1 .and. mon == 1
442200 elseif(inithist == 'CAMIOP' ) then
442300 write_inithist = nstep == 0
442400 elseif(inithist == 'ENDOFRUN' ) then
442500 write_inithist = nstep /= 0 .and. is_last_step()
4426 end if
4427 end if
4428
4429 return
4430105984105984 end function write_inithist

44342662426624 subroutine wshist (rgnht_in)
4435 !
4436 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4437 !
4438 ! Purpose: Driver routine to write fields on history tape t

4440 ! Method: For variables which do not need to be gathered (SPMD) just issue the netcdf call
4441 ! For those that do need to be gathered, call "dump_field" to do the operation.

4457 ! Local workspace

4461

4484 integer :: ierr

4488 integer :: tsec ! day component of current time

4490#endif
4491 real(r8) :: kp, ap, f107, f107a
4492
4493 !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
4494 ! get solar/geomagnetic activity data...
44952662426624 call solar_parms_get( f107_s=f107, f107a_s=f107a, ap_s=ap, kp_s=kp )
4496
44972662479872 if(present(rgnht_in)) then
449861447168 rgnht=rgnht_in
4499512512 restart=.true.
4500 tape => restarthistory_tape
4501 else
4502313344365568 rgnht=.false.
45032611226112 restart=.false.
4504 tape => history_tape
4505 end if
4506
45072662453248 nstep = get_nstep()
45082662426624 call get_curr_date(yr, mon, day, ncsec)
45092662426624 ncdate = yr*10000 + mon*100 + day
45102662426624 call get_curr_time(ndcur, nscur)
4511 !
4512 ! Write time-varying portion of history file header
4513 !
4514319488346112 do t=1,ptapes
4515319488373760 if (nflds(t) == 0 .or. (restart .and.(.not.rgnht(t)))) cycle
4516 !
4517 ! Check if this is the IC file and if it's time to write.
4518 ! Else, use "nhtfrq" to determine if it's time to write

4520 !
45215273653248 if((.not. restart) .or. rgnht(t)) then
452252736105472 if( is_initfile(file_index=t) ) then
45232611252224 hstwr(t) = write_inithist()
4524 prev = .false.
4525 else
45262662426624 if (nhtfrq(t) == 0) then
452726624186368 hstwr(t) = nstep /= 0 .and. day == 1 .and. ncsec == 0
4528 prev = .true.
4529 else
453000 hstwr(t) = mod(nstep,nhtfrq(t)) == 0
4531 prev = .false.
4532 end if
4533 end if
4534 end if
453552736105984 if (hstwr(t) .or. (restart .and. rgnht(t))) then
4536512512 if(masterproc) then
453712 if(is_initfile(file_index=t)) then
453800 write(iulog,100) yr,mon,day,ncsec
4539100 format('WSHIST: writing time sample to Initial Conditions h-file', &
4540 ' DATE=',i4.4,'/',i2.2,'/',i2.2,' NCSEC=',i6)
454112 else if(is_satfile(t)) then
454200 write(iulog,150) nfils(t),t,yr,mon,day,ncsec
4543150 format('WSHIST: writing sat columns ',i6,' to h-file ', &
4544 i1,' DATE=',i4.4,'/',i2.2,'/',i2.2,' NCSEC=',i6)
454511 else if(hstwr(t)) then
454600 write(iulog,200) nfils(t),t,yr,mon,day,ncsec
4547200 format('WSHIST: writing time sample ',i3,' to h-file ', &
4548 i1,' DATE=',i4.4,'/',i2.2,'/',i2.2,' NCSEC=',i6)
454912 else if(restart .and. rgnht(t)) then
455017 write(iulog,300) nfils(t),t,yr,mon,day,ncsec
4551300 format('WSHIST: writing history restart ',i3,' to hr-file ', &
4552 i1,' DATE=',i4.4,'/',i2.2,'/',i2.2,' NCSEC=',i6)
4553 end if
455412 write(iulog,*)
4555 end if
4556 !
4557 ! Starting a new volume => define the metadata
4558 !
4559512512 if (nfils(t)==0 .or. (restart.and.rgnht(t))) then
4560512512 if(restart) then
45615122048 rhfilename_spec = '%c.cam' // trim(inst_suffix) // '.rh%t.%y-%m-%d-%s.nc'
45625121024 fname = interpret_filename_spec( rhfilename_spec, number=(t-1))
4563512512 hrestpath(t)=fname
456400 else if(is_initfile(file_index=t)) then
456500 fname = interpret_filename_spec( hfilename_spec(t) )
4566 else
456700 fname = interpret_filename_spec( hfilename_spec(t), number=(t-1), &
4568 prev=prev )
4569 end if
4570 !
4571 ! Check that this new filename isn't the same as a previous or current filename
4572 !
457361446656 do f = 1, ptapes
4574614430732 if (masterproc.and. trim(fname) == trim(nhfil(f)) )then
457500 write(iulog,*)'WSHIST: New filename same as old file = ', trim(fname)
457600 write(iulog,*)'Is there an error in your filename specifiers?'
457700 write(iulog,*)'hfilename_spec(', t, ') = ', hfilename_spec(t)
457800 if ( t /= f )then
457900 write(iulog,*)'hfilename_spec(', f, ') = ', hfilename_spec(f)
4580 end if
458100 call endrun
4582 end if
4583 end do
4584512512 if(.not. restart) then
458500 nhfil(t) = fname
458600 if(masterproc) write(iulog,*)'WSHIST: nhfil(',t,')=',trim(nhfil(t))
458700 cpath(t) = nhfil(t)
458800 if ( len_trim(nfpath(t)) == 0 ) nfpath(t) = cpath(t)
4589 end if
4590512512 call h_define (t, restart)
4591 end if
4592
45935121024 if(is_satfile(t)) then
459400 call sat_hist_write( tape(t), nflds(t), nfils(t))
4595 else
4596512512 if(restart) then
4597512512 start=1
4598 else
459900 nfils(t) = nfils(t) + 1
4600 start = nfils(t)
4601 end if
4602512512 count1 = 1
4603
4604
46055124608 ierr = pio_put_var (tape(t)%File, tape(t)%ndcurid,(/start/), (/count1/),(/ndcur/))
46065124608 ierr = pio_put_var (tape(t)%File, tape(t)%nscurid,(/start/), (/count1/),(/nscur/))
46075124608 ierr = pio_put_var (tape(t)%File, tape(t)%dateid,(/start/), (/count1/),(/ncdate/))
4608
46095121024 if (.not. is_initfile(file_index=t)) then
4610 ! Don't write the GHG/Solar forcing data to the IC file.
46115125632 ierr=pio_put_var (tape(t)%File, tape(t)%co2vmrid,(/start/), (/count1/),(/chem_surfvals_co2_rad(vmr_in=.true.)/))
46125125632 ierr=pio_put_var (tape(t)%File, tape(t)%ch4vmrid,(/start/), (/count1/),(/chem_surfvals_get('CH4VMR')/))
46135125632 ierr=pio_put_var (tape(t)%File, tape(t)%n2ovmrid,(/start/), (/count1/),(/chem_surfvals_get('N2OVMR')/))
46145125632 ierr=pio_put_var (tape(t)%File, tape(t)%f11vmrid,(/start/), (/count1/),(/chem_surfvals_get('F11VMR')/))
46155125632 ierr=pio_put_var (tape(t)%File, tape(t)%f12vmrid,(/start/), (/count1/),(/chem_surfvals_get('F12VMR')/))
46165124608 ierr=pio_put_var (tape(t)%File, tape(t)%sol_tsiid,(/start/), (/count1/),(/sol_tsi/))
4617
4618 if (solar_parms_on) then
461900 ierr=pio_put_var (tape(t)%File, tape(t)%f107id, (/start/), (/count1/),(/ f107 /) )
462000 ierr=pio_put_var (tape(t)%File, tape(t)%f107aid,(/start/), (/count1/),(/ f107a /) )
462100 ierr=pio_put_var (tape(t)%File, tape(t)%kpid, (/start/), (/count1/),(/ kp /) )
462200 ierr=pio_put_var (tape(t)%File, tape(t)%apid, (/start/), (/count1/),(/ ap /) )
4623 endif
4624
4625 end if
4626
4627
4628
46295124608 ierr = pio_put_var (tape(t)%File, tape(t)%datesecid,(/start/),(/count1/),(/ncsec/))
4630#if ( defined BFB_CAM_SCAM_IOP )
4631 dtime = get_step_size()
4632 tsec=dtime*nstep
4633 ierr = pio_put_var (tape(t)%File, tape(t)%tsecid,(/start/),(/count1/),(/tsec/))
4634#endif
46355124608 ierr = pio_put_var (tape(t)%File, tape(t)%nstephid,(/start/),(/count1/),(/nstep/))
4636 time = ndcur + nscur/86400._r8
46375124608 ierr=pio_put_var (tape(t)%File, tape(t)%timeid, (/start/),(/count1/),(/time/))
4638
4639 startc(1) = 1
4640 startc(2) = start
4641 countc(1) = 2
4642 countc(2) = 1
46435121024 if (is_initfile(file_index=t)) then
464400 tdata = time ! Inithist file is always instantanious data
4645 else
4646512512 tdata(1) = beg_time(t)
4647 tdata(2) = time
4648 end if
46495121536 ierr=pio_put_var (tape(t)%File, tape(t)%tbndid, startc, countc, tdata)
465000 if(.not.restart) beg_time(t) = time ! update beginning time of next interval
4651512512 startc(1) = 1
4652 startc(2) = start
4653 countc(1) = 8
4654 countc(2) = 1
4655512512 call datetime (cdate, ctime)
46565124096 ierr = pio_put_var (tape(t)%File, tape(t)%date_writtenid, startc, countc, (/cdate/))
46575123584 ierr = pio_put_var (tape(t)%File, tape(t)%time_writtenid, startc, countc, (/ctime/))
4658
4659 if(.not. restart) then
4660 !$OMP PARALLEL DO PRIVATE (F)
466100 do f=1,nflds(t)
4662 ! Normalized averaged fields
466300 if (tape(t)%hlist(f)%avgflag /= 'I') then
466400 call h_normalize (f, t)
4665 end if
4666 end do
4667 end if
4668 !
4669 ! Write field to history tape. Note that this is NOT threaded due to netcdf limitations
4670 !
4671512512 call t_startf ('dump_field')

4674 end do

4678 !
4679
4680
4681
4682512512 if(restart) then
46839420894720 do f=1,nflds(t)
468494208282624 if(associated(tape(t)%hlist(f)%varid)) then
468594208282624 deallocate(tape(t)%hlist(f)%varid)
46869420894208 nullify(tape(t)%hlist(f)%varid)
4687 end if
4688 end do
4689512512 call pio_closefile(tape(t)%File)
4690 else
4691 !$OMP PARALLEL DO PRIVATE (F)
469200 do f=1,nflds(t)
469300 call h_zero (f, t)
4694 end do
4695 end if
4696 end if
4697 end if
4698
4699 end do
4700
4701 return
47022662426624 end subroutine wshist

4922 ! Mark whether this field is to be output as a subcolumn field

4927

4932 case(pverp)

4939!

494210204161020416 nullify (listentry%field%colperdim3)

4946 listentry%field%enddim1 = pcols

4948 listentry%field%enddim2 = numlev
4949 listentry%field%begdim3 = begchunk
4950 listentry%field%enddim3 = endchunk

4954 listentry%field%colperdim3(c) = ncol

495700 listentry%field%begdim1 = beglonxy
4958 listentry%field%enddim1 = endlonxy
4959 listentry%field%begdim2 = 1
4960 listentry%field%enddim2 = numlev
4961 listentry%field%begdim3 = beglatxy
4962 listentry%field%enddim3 = endlatxy
4963 case (dyn_decomp)
496420484096 if ( dycore_is('LR') )then
496500 listentry%field%begdim1 = beglonxy
4966 listentry%field%enddim1 = endlonxy
4967 listentry%field%begdim2 = 1
4968 listentry%field%enddim2 = numlev
4969 listentry%field%begdim3 = beglatxy
4970 listentry%field%enddim3 = endlatxy
4971 else
497220482048 listentry%field%begdim3 = beglat
4973 listentry%field%enddim3 = endlat

4986 case default

498800 call endrun ()

4990
499110204163061248 if(present(begdim1)) then

499300 call endrun('ADDFLD: begdim1 not allowed for subcolumn fields')

499710204163061248 if(present(enddim1)) then
499820482048 if (listentry%field%is_subcol) then
499900 call endrun('ADDFLD: enddim1 not allowed for subcolumn fields')
5000 end if
500120482048 listentry%field%enddim1 = enddim1
5002 end if
500310204163061248 if(present(begdim2)) then
500400 if (listentry%field%is_subcol) then
500500 call endrun('ADDFLD: begdim2 not allowed for subcolumn fields')
5006 end if
500700 listentry%field%begdim2 = begdim2
5008 end if
500910204163061248 if(present(enddim2)) then
501000 if (listentry%field%is_subcol) then

501510204163061248 if(present(begdim3)) then
501620482048 if (listentry%field%is_subcol) then
501700 call endrun('ADDFLD: begdim3 not allowed for subcolumn fields')
5018 end if

5020 end if
502110204163061248 if(present(enddim3)) then
502220482048 if (listentry%field%is_subcol) then
502300 call endrun('ADDFLD: enddim3 not allowed for subcolumn fields')

5027
5028
5029
5030!

50331224499238775808 listentry%avgflag(:) = avgflag
50341224499214285824 listentry%actflag(:) = .false.
5035

50762611226112 subroutine wrapup (rstwr, nlend)
5077!
5078!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5079!
5080! Purpose:
5081! Close history files.
5082!
5083! Method:
5084! This routine will close any full hist. files
5085! or any hist. file that has data on it when restart files are being
5086! written.
5087! If a partially full history file was disposed (for restart
5088! purposes), then wrapup will open that unit back up and position
5089! it for appending new data.
5090!
5091! Original version: CCM2
5092!
5093!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5094!
5095 use pio, only : pio_file_is_open
5096 use shr_kind_mod, only: r8 => shr_kind_r8
5097 use pspect
5098 use ioFileMod
5099 use time_manager, only: get_nstep, get_curr_date, get_curr_time
5100 use cam_pio_utils, only: cam_pio_openfile
5101
5102!
5103! Input arguments
5104!
5105 logical, intent(in) :: rstwr ! true => restart files are written this timestep
5106 logical, intent(in) :: nlend ! Flag if time to end
5107
5108!
5109! Local workspace
5110!
5111 integer :: nstep ! current timestep number
5112 integer :: ncdate ! current date in integer format [yyyymmdd]
5113 integer :: ncsec ! time of day relative to current date [seconds]
5114 integer :: ndcur ! days component of current time
5115 integer :: nscur ! seconds component of current time
5116 integer :: yr, mon, day ! year, month, day components of a date
5117
5118 logical lfill (ptapes) ! Is history file ready to dispose?
5119 logical hdispose(ptapes) ! Primary file disposed
5120 logical lhdisp ! true => history file is disposed
5121 logical lhfill ! true => history file is full
5122
5123 integer t ! History file number
5124 integer f
5125 integer :: ierr
5126 real(r8) tday ! Model day number for printout
5127!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5128
51292611226112 tape => history_tape
5130
51312611252224 nstep = get_nstep()
51322611226112 call get_curr_date(yr, mon, day, ncsec)
51332611226112 ncdate = yr*10000 + mon*100 + day
51342611226112 call get_curr_time(ndcur, nscur)
5135!
5136!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5137! Dispose history files.
5138!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5139!
5140! Begin loop over ptapes (the no. of declared history files - primary
5141! and auxiliary). This loop disposes a history file to Mass Store
5142! when appropriate.
5143!
5144313344339456 do t=1,ptapes
5145313344313344 if (nflds(t) == 0) cycle
5146
51475222452224 hdispose(t) = .false.
5148 lfill(t) = .false.
5149!
5150! Find out if file is full
5151!
515200 if (hstwr(t) .and. nfils(t) >= mfilt(t)) then
515300 lfill(t) = .true.
5154 endif
5155!
5156! Dispose history file if
5157! 1) file is filled or
5158! 2) this is the end of run and file has data on it or
5159! 3) restarts are being put out and history file has data on it
5160!
516152224158720 if (lfill(t) .or. (nlend .and. nfils(t) >= 1) .or. (rstwr .and. nfils(t) >= 1)) then
5162!
5163! Dispose history file
5164!
516500 hdispose(t) = .true.
5166!
5167! Is this the 0 timestep data of a monthly run?
5168! If so, just close primary unit do not dispose.
5169!
517000 if (masterproc) write(iulog,*)'WRAPUP: nf_close(',t,')=',trim(nhfil(t))
517100 if(pio_file_is_open(tape(t)%File)) then
517200 if (nlend .or. lfill(t)) then
517300 do f=1,nflds(t)
517400 if (associated(tape(t)%hlist(f)%varid)) then
517500 deallocate(tape(t)%hlist(f)%varid)
517600 nullify(tape(t)%hlist(f)%varid)
5177 end if
5178 end do
5179 end if
518000 call PIO_CloseFile (tape(t)%File)
5181 end if
518200 if (nhtfrq(t) /= 0 .or. nstep > 0) then
5183
5184!
5185! Print information concerning model output.
5186! Model day number = iteration number of history file data * delta-t / (seconds per day)
5187!
518800 tday = ndcur + nscur/86400._r8
5189 if(masterproc) then
519000 if (t==1) then
519100 write(iulog,*)' Primary history file'
5192 else
519300 write(iulog,*)' Auxiliary history file number ', t-1
5194 end if
519500 write(iulog,9003)nstep,nfils(t),tday
519600 write(iulog,9004)
5197 end if
5198 !
5199! Auxilary files may have been closed and saved off without being full.
5200! We must reopen the files and position them for more data.
5201! Must position auxiliary files if not full
5202!
520300 if (.not.nlend .and. .not.lfill(t)) then
520400 call cam_PIO_openfile (tape(t)%File, nhfil(t), PIO_WRITE)
520500 call h_inquire(t)
5206 end if
5207 endif ! if 0 timestep of montly run****
5208 end if ! if time dispose history fiels***
5209 end do ! do ptapes
5210!
5211! Reset number of files on each history tape
5212!
5213313344339456 do t=1,ptapes
5214313344313344 if (nflds(t) == 0) cycle
521552224156672 lhfill = hstwr(t) .and. nfils(t) >= mfilt(t)
521652224156672 lhdisp = lhfill .or. (nlend .and. nfils(t) >= 1) .or. &
52175222452224 (rstwr .and. nfils(t) >= 1)
521800 if (lhfill.and.lhdisp) then
521900 nfils(t) = 0
5220 endif
5221 end do
5222 return
52239003 format(' Output at NSTEP = ',i10,/, &
5224 ' Number of time samples on this file = ',i10,/, &
5225 ' Model Day = ',f10.2)
52269004 format('---------------------------------------')
52272611226112 end subroutine wrapup
5228
5229
52309625088096250880 integer function gen_hash_key(string)
5231!dir$ INLINENEVER gen_hash_key
5232!
5233!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5234!
5235! Purpose: Generate a hash key on the interval [0 .. tbl_hash_pri_sz-1]
5236! given a character string.
5237!
5238! Algorithm is a variant of perl's internal hashing function.
5239!
5240!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5241!
5242 implicit none
5243!
5244! Arguments:
5245!
5246 character(len=*), intent(in) :: string
5247!
5248! Local.
5249!
5250 integer :: hash
5251 integer :: i
5252
52539625088096250880 hash = gen_hash_key_offset
5254
5255 if ( len(string) /= 19 ) then
5256!
5257! Process arbitrary string length.
5258!
525925987737602695024640 do i = 1, len(string)
5260 hash = ieor(hash , (ichar(string(i:i)) * tbl_gen_hash_key(iand(i-1,tbl_max_idx))))
5261 end do
5262 else
5263!
5264! Special case string length = 19
5265!
526600 hash = ieor(hash , ichar(string(1:1)) * 61)
5267 hash = ieor(hash , ichar(string(2:2)) * 59)
5268 hash = ieor(hash , ichar(string(3:3)) * 53)
5269 hash = ieor(hash , ichar(string(4:4)) * 47)
5270 hash = ieor(hash , ichar(string(5:5)) * 43)
5271 hash = ieor(hash , ichar(string(6:6)) * 41)
5272 hash = ieor(hash , ichar(string(7:7)) * 37)
5273 hash = ieor(hash , ichar(string(8:8)) * 31)
5274 hash = ieor(hash , ichar(string(9:9)) * 29)
5275 hash = ieor(hash , ichar(string(10:10)) * 23)
5276 hash = ieor(hash , ichar(string(11:11)) * 17)
5277 hash = ieor(hash , ichar(string(12:12)) * 13)
5278 hash = ieor(hash , ichar(string(13:13)) * 11)
5279 hash = ieor(hash , ichar(string(14:14)) * 7)
5280 hash = ieor(hash , ichar(string(15:15)) * 3)
5281 hash = ieor(hash , ichar(string(16:16)) * 1)
5282 hash = ieor(hash , ichar(string(17:17)) * 61)
5283 hash = ieor(hash , ichar(string(18:18)) * 59)
5284 hash = ieor(hash , ichar(string(19:19)) * 53)
5285 end if
5286
52879625088096250880 gen_hash_key = iand(hash, tbl_hash_pri_sz-1)
5288
5289 return
5290
52919625088096250880 end function gen_hash_key

52959421004894210048 integer function get_masterlist_indx(fldname)
5296!
5297!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5298!
5299! Purpose: Return the the index of the field's name on the master file list.
5300!
5301! If the field is not found on the masterlist, return -1.
5302!
5303!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5304!
5305! Arguments:
5306!
5307 character(len=*), intent(in) :: fldname
5308!
5309! Local.
5310!
5311 integer :: hash_key
5312 integer :: ff
5313 integer :: ii
5314 integer :: io ! Index of overflow chain in overflow table
5315 integer :: in ! Number of entries on overflow chain
5316
531794210048282630144 hash_key = gen_hash_key(fldname)
5318 ff = tbl_hash_pri(hash_key)
5319 if ( ff < 0 ) then
53202355353623553536 io = abs(ff)
5321 in = tbl_hash_oflow(io)
53221382348813823488 do ii = 1, in
53233737702437377024 ff = tbl_hash_oflow(io+ii)
53243737702437377024 if ( masterlist(ff)%thisentry%field%name == fldname ) exit
5325 end do
5326 end if
5327
53289421004894210048 if (ff == 0) then
5329 ! fldname generated a hash key that doesn't have an entry in tbl_hash_pri.
5330 ! This means that fldname isn't in the masterlist
533100 call endrun ('GET_MASTERLIST_INDX: attemping to output field '//fldname//' not on master list')
5332 end if
5333
533494210048471050240 if (associated(masterlist(ff)%thisentry) .and. masterlist(ff)%thisentry%field%name /= fldname ) then
533500 call endrun ('GET_MASTERLIST_INDX: error finding field '//fldname//' on master list')
5336 end if
5337
53389421004894210048 get_masterlist_indx = ff
5339 return
53409421004894210048 end function get_masterlist_indx

5343512512 subroutine bld_outfld_hash_tbls()
5344!
5345!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5346!
5347! Purpose: Build primary and overflow hash tables for outfld processing.
5348!
5349! Steps:
5350! 1) Foreach field on masterlist, find all collisions.
5351! 2) Given the number of collisions, verify overflow table has sufficient
5352! space.
5353! 3) Build primary and overflow indices.
5354!
5355!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5356!
5357! Local.
5358!
5359 integer :: ff
5360 integer :: ii
5361 integer :: itemp
5362 integer :: ncollisions
5363 integer :: hash_key
5364 type(master_entry), pointer :: listentry
5365!
5366! 1) Find all collisions.
5367!
53683355443233555456 tbl_hash_pri = 0
5369
5370512512 ff=0
537110204161024000 allocate(masterlist(nfmaster))
5372512512 listentry=>masterlinkedlist
537310209283062784 do while(associated(listentry))
537410204161020416 ff=ff+1
5375 masterlist(ff)%thisentry=>listentry
5376 listentry=>listentry%next_entry
5377 end do
5378512512 if(ff /= nfmaster) then
537900 write(iulog,*) 'nfmaster = ',nfmaster, ' ff=',ff
538000 call endrun('mismatch in expected size of nfmaster')
5381 end if
5382
5383
538410204161020928 do ff = 1, nfmaster
538510204161020416 hash_key = gen_hash_key(masterlist(ff)%thisentry%field%name)
5386 tbl_hash_pri(hash_key) = tbl_hash_pri(hash_key) + 1
5387 end do
5388
5389!
5390! 2) Count number of collisions and define start of a individual
5391! collision's chain in overflow table. A collision is defined to be any
5392! location in tbl_hash_pri that has a value > 1.
5393!
5394512512 ncollisions = 0
53953355443233554432 do ii = 0, tbl_hash_pri_sz-1
53963355443233554432 if ( tbl_hash_pri(ii) > 1 ) then ! Define start of chain in O.F. table
5397116736116736 itemp = tbl_hash_pri(ii)
5398 tbl_hash_pri(ii) = -(ncollisions + 1)
5399 ncollisions = ncollisions + itemp + 1
5400 end if
5401 end do
5402
5403512512 if ( ncollisions > tbl_hash_oflow_sz ) then
540400 write(iulog,*) 'BLD_OUTFLD_HASH_TBLS: ncollisions > tbl_hash_oflow_sz', &
5405 ncollisions, tbl_hash_oflow_sz
540600 call endrun()
5407 end if
5408
5409!
5410! 3) Build primary and overflow tables.
5411! i - set collisions in tbl_hash_pri to point to their respective
5412! chain in the overflow table.
5413!
541467107846711808 tbl_hash_oflow = 0
5415
541610204161020928 do ff = 1, nfmaster
541710204162040832 hash_key = gen_hash_key(masterlist(ff)%thisentry%field%name)
5418 if ( tbl_hash_pri(hash_key) < 0 ) then
5419249856249856 ii = abs(tbl_hash_pri(hash_key))
5420 tbl_hash_oflow(ii) = tbl_hash_oflow(ii) + 1
5421 tbl_hash_oflow(ii+tbl_hash_oflow(ii)) = ff
5422 else
5423770560770560 tbl_hash_pri(hash_key) = ff
5424 end if
5425 end do
5426
5427!
5428! Dump out primary and overflow hashing tables.
5429!
5430! if ( masterproc ) then
5431! do ii = 0, tbl_hash_pri_sz-1
5432! if ( tbl_hash_pri(ii) /= 0 ) write(iulog,666) 'tbl_hash_pri', ii, tbl_hash_pri(ii)
5433! end do
5434!
5435! do ii = 1, tbl_hash_oflow_sz
5436! if ( tbl_hash_oflow(ii) /= 0 ) write(iulog,666) 'tbl_hash_oflow', ii, tbl_hash_oflow(ii)
5437! end do
5438!
5439! itemp = 0
5440! ii = 1
5441! do
5442! if ( tbl_hash_oflow(ii) == 0 ) exit
5443! itemp = itemp + 1
5444! write(iulog,*) 'Overflow chain ', itemp, ' has ', tbl_hash_oflow(ii), ' entries:'
5445! do ff = 1, tbl_hash_oflow(ii) ! dump out colliding names on this chain
5446! write(iulog,*) ' ', ff, ' = ', tbl_hash_oflow(ii+ff), &
5447! ' ', masterlist(tbl_hash_oflow(ii+ff))%thisentry%field%name
5448! end do
5449! ii = ii + tbl_hash_oflow(ii) +1 !advance pointer to start of next chain
5450! end do
5451! end if
5452
5453 return
5454666 format(1x, a, '(', i4, ')', 1x, i6)
5455
5456512512 end subroutine bld_outfld_hash_tbls

5460512512 subroutine bld_htapefld_indices
5461!
5462!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5463!
5464! Purpose: Set history tape field indicies in masterlist for each
5465! field defined on every tape.
5466!
5467! Note: because of restart processing, the actflag field is cleared and
5468! then set only for active output fields on the different history
5469! tapes.
5470!
5471!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5472!
5473! Arguments:
5474!
5475
5476!
5477! Local.
5478!
5479 integer :: f
5480 integer :: t
5481
5482!
5483! Initialize htapeindx to an invalid value.
5484!
5485 type(master_entry), pointer :: listentry
5486
5487 ! reset all the active flags to false
5488 ! this is needed so that restarts work properly -- fvitt
5489512512 listentry=>masterlinkedlist
549010209283062784 do while(associated(listentry))
54911224499214285824 listentry%actflag(:) = .false.
549210204161020416 listentry%act_sometape = .false.
5493 listentry=>listentry%next_entry
5494 end do
5495
549661446656 do t = 1, ptapes
5497125440131584 do f = 1, nflds(t)
5498125440250880 listentry => get_entry_by_name(masterlinkedlist, tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%name)
5499125440250880 if(.not.associated(listentry)) then
550000 write(iulog,*) 'BLD_HTAPEFLD_INDICES: something wrong, field not found on masterlist'
550100 write(iulog,*) 'BLD_HTAPEFLD_INDICES: t, f, ff = ', t, f
550200 write(iulog,*) 'BLD_HTAPEFLD_INDICES: tape%name = ', tape(t)%hlist(f)%field%name
550300 call endrun
5504 end if
5505 listentry%act_sometape = .true.
5506 listentry%actflag(t) = .true.
5507 listentry%htapeindx(t) = f
5508 end do
5509 end do
5510
5511!
5512! set flag indicating h-tape contents are now defined (needed by addfld)
5513!
5514512512 htapes_defined = .true.
5515
5516 return
5517512512 end subroutine bld_htapefld_indices

5551 function hist_fld_col_active(fname, lchnk)
5552
5553! Determine whether each column in a field is active on any history file.
5554! The purpose of this routine is to provide information which would allow
5555! a diagnostic physics parameterization to only be run on a subset of
5556! columns in the case when only column or regional output is requested.
5557!
5558! **N.B.** The field is assumed to be using the physics decomposition.
5559
5560 use phys_grid, only: get_ncols_p, get_lat_all_p, get_lon_all_p
5561
5562 ! Arguments
5563 character(len=*), intent(in) :: fname ! Field name
5564 integer, intent(in) :: lchnk ! chunk ID
5565
5566 ! Return value
5567 logical :: hist_fld_col_active(pcols)
5568
5569 ! Local variables
5570 character*(max_fieldname_len) :: fname_loc ! max-char equivalent of fname
5571
5572 integer :: ff ! masterlist index pointer
5573 integer :: i
5574 integer :: t ! history file (tape) index
5575 integer :: igp, iub ! column group indices
5576 integer :: ilats(pcols)
5577 integer :: ilons(pcols)
5578 integer :: ncol, lon1, lon2, lat1, lat2
5579
5580 type (active_entry), pointer :: tape(:)
5581
5582!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
5583
5584 ! Initialize to false. Then look to see if and where active.
5585 hist_fld_col_active = .false.
5586
5587 ! Check for name in the master list.
5588 fname_loc = fname
5589 ff = get_masterlist_indx(fname_loc)
5590
5591 ! If not in master list then return.
5592 if ( ff < 0 ) return
5593
5594 ! If in master list, but not active on any file then return
5595 if (.not. masterlist(ff)%thisentry%act_sometape) return
5596
5597 ! Loop over history files and check for the field/column in each one
5598
5599 tape => history_tape
5600 do t = 1, ptapes
5601
5602 ! Is the field active in this file? If not the cycle to next file.
5603 if (.not. masterlist(ff)%thisentry%actflag(t)) cycle
5604
5605 ! Check whether this file has column output.
5606 if (tape(t)%column(1)%lat_name == ' ') then
5607
5608 ! No column output has been requested. In that case the field has
5609 ! global output which implies all columns are active. No need to
5610 ! check any other history files.
5611 hist_fld_col_active = .true.
5612 exit
5613
5614 else if (associated(tape(t)%column(1)%hmask)) then
5615
5616 ! All column output is collected into a single group for output.
5617 ncol = get_ncols_p(lchnk)
5618 do i = 1, ncol
5619 if (tape(t)%column(1)%hmask(i,lchnk) > 0) then
5620 hist_fld_col_active(i) = .true.
5621 end if
5622 end do
5623
5624 else
5625
5626 ! Column output has been requested, and multiple columns/regions
5627 ! are possible. Need to loop over the groups
5628
5629 ! The column group info is stored as indices into the global array.
5630 ! Retrieve the global indices for the columns in the chunk.
5631
5632 ncol = get_ncols_p(lchnk)
5633 call get_lat_all_p(lchnk, pcols, ilats)
5634 call get_lon_all_p(lchnk, pcols, ilons)
5635
5636 do igp = 1, ngroup(t)
5637 lon1 = tape(t)%column(igp)%columnlon(1)
5638 lon2 = tape(t)%column(igp)%columnlon(2)
5639 lat1 = tape(t)%column(igp)%columnlat(1)
5640 lat2 = tape(t)%column(igp)%columnlat(2)
5641
5642 ! Is the column in the group
5643 do i = 1, ncol
5644 ! only need to check if the column has not already been
5645 ! identified as active
5646 if (.not. hist_fld_col_active(i)) then
5647 if ( ilons(i) >= lon1 .and. ilons(i) <= lon2 .and. &
5648 ilats(i) >= lat1 .and. ilats(i) <= lat2 ) then
5649 hist_fld_col_active(i) = .true.
5650 end if
5651 end if
5652 end do ! columns in chunk
5653
5654 end do ! groups in history file
5655
5656 end if
5657
5658 end do ! history files
5659
5660 end function hist_fld_col_active
5661
5662end module cam_history
